# King Diamond facts for kids

[Kids Encyclopedia Facts](link_0)

This page is about the musician. For the associated band, see King Diamond (band).

| Quick facts for kids King Diamond |
| --- |
| [![Image 3: Mercyful Fate - 2022216204958 2022-08-04 Wacken - Sven - 1D X MK II - 2326 - B70I4217.jpg](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/b/b1/Mercyful_Fate_-_2022216204958_2022-08-04_Wacken_-_Sven_-_1D_X_MK_II_-_2326_-_B70I4217.jpg/300px-Mercyful_Fate_-_2022216204958_2022-08-04_Wacken_-_Sven_-_1D_X_MK_II_-_2326_-_B70I4217.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Mercyful_Fate_-_2022216204958_2022-08-04_Wacken_-_Sven_-_1D_X_MK_II_-_2326_-_B70I4217.jpg) King Diamond performing in 2022 |

**Kim Bendix Petersen** (born on June 14, 1956), known as **King Diamond**, is a Danish rock musician. He is famous for his powerful singing voice, especially his high-pitched screams. He is the main singer and songwriter for two bands: Mercyful Fate and his own band, King Diamond.

While he plays keyboards and guitar on his albums, he focuses only on singing during live shows. King Diamond is well-known for his dark song lyrics and the stories he tells through his music. He also has a unique stage look, often wearing black and white face paint. Many other rock and metal artists, like [Metallica](link_6) and Slayer, have been influenced by his work.

## Music Career Highlights

### Starting Out in Music

King Diamond's first heavy rock band was called Brainstorm, from 1974 to 1976. After that, he sang with a Danish hard rock band called Black Rose. With Black Rose, he started adding horror-themed performances to his shows. He also began developing his unique stage character.

Later, he joined a punk-metal band called Brats, where he met Hank Shermann. They then helped another musician, Michael Denner, with his project, Danger Zone. This group, including Timi Hansen, eventually formed the band Mercyful Fate in 1980.

### Mercyful Fate Band

Main article: Mercyful Fate

After releasing their album _Don't Break the Oath_ in 1984 and touring the U.S. for the first time, King Diamond decided to start a solo career. He took two bandmates, Timi Hansen and Michael Denner, with him.

Mercyful Fate got back together in 1992. King Diamond continued his solo career at the same time. The band recorded five more albums. In 1999, King Diamond and Hank Shermann performed the song "Evil" live with [Metallica](link_6). During this performance, King Diamond did not wear his famous makeup.

[![Image 4: King Diamond live 1999](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/0/0d/King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg/300px-King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg "Enlarge")

 King Diamond performing in 1999

In 2000, King Diamond decided to pause Mercyful Fate to focus on his solo music. However, on August 1, 2019, Mercyful Fate announced they would reunite for a European tour. In June 2022, they released a new song called "The Jackal of Salzburg." King Diamond confirmed in August 2022 that the band was working on a new album.

### King Diamond Solo Project

Main article: King Diamond (band)

In 2001, King Diamond sang backup vocals on a song called "Necronemesis" for the band Usurper. In 2004, he sang on "Sweet Dreams," a song by [Dave Grohl](link_7)'s heavy metal project, Probot. In late 2005, King Diamond also sang on the _Roadrunner United – The All-Star Sessions_ album for the song "In the Fire." He also appeared on the Cradle of Filth song "Devil Woman" in late 2005.

In April 2006, King Diamond performed with [Mikkey Dee](link_8), the drummer for [Motörhead](link_9), in Sweden. King Diamond had previously called Dee "one of the best drummers of all time."

King Diamond released his album _Give Me Your Soul... Please_ on June 26, 2007. The band was nominated for a [Grammy](link_10) Award for "Best Metal Performance" for their song "Never Ending Hill."

He had to cancel a U.S. tour because of severe back pain from a herniated disk. He believed the problem came from the long, stressful hours spent working on his album.

King Diamond appeared at Ozzfest on August 9, 2008, in Frisco, Texas. He performed a mix of Mercyful Fate songs with [Metallica](link_6). He also sang a cover of the Pantera song "A New Level" with other musicians.

In 2009, King Diamond became a playable character in the video game _Guitar Hero: Metallica_. Players could unlock him by completing Mercyful Fate's song "Evil."

On November 29, 2010, King Diamond was hospitalized. Doctors found blockages in his arteries and determined he had experienced several heart attacks. He needed triple-bypass surgery, which was successful. He recovered at home, and all his music projects were put on hold temporarily.

On December 7, 2011, King Diamond joined Metallica on stage in San Francisco to celebrate Metallica's 30th anniversary. In June 2012, he performed his comeback concert at the Sweden Rock Festival.

On September 8, 2012, King Diamond appeared on VH1 Classic's _That Metal Show_ with Mark Tremonti. He discussed his surgery and upcoming plans.

[![Image 5: Tuska 20130628 - King Diamond - 32](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/5/5a/Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg/300px-Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg "Enlarge")

 King Diamond in 2013

He provided guest vocals on the song "Room 24" for [Volbeat](link_11)'s 2013 album, _Outlaw Gentlemen & Shady Ladies_. In August 2013, King Diamond performed at the Open Air Bloodstock Festival in the UK.

Slayer was the main band for the 2015 Rockstar Energy Mayhem Festival. King Diamond's band also participated in this tour, along with other groups like HELLYEAH and [The Devil Wears Prada](link_12).

#### Other Appearances

King Diamond was a special guest star in four episodes of the [Warner Bros.](https://kids.kiddle.co/Warner_Bros [link_13]. "Warner Bros.") cartoon _Metalocalypse_ in 2006. He voiced characters like the Blues Devil and a fast food manager.

## Stage Performance

When King Diamond performs on stage, he uses a special microphone stand. It is made from a [femur](link_14) bone and a [tibia](link_15) bone shaped like a [cross](link_16). He used to use a real [human skull](link_17) named Melissa on stage, but it was stolen after a show in the Netherlands in the mid-1980s.

King Diamond has often changed his makeup design over the years. For his album _Conspiracy_, he wore black and white lines that looked like war paint, with some red "blood" on his forehead. For his album _The Puppet Master_, he used less white makeup and mostly had black crosses on his face.

## Musical Inspirations

King Diamond says that musicians like Arthur Brown, David Byron, [Alice Cooper](link_18), [Ronnie James Dio](link_19), [Ian Gillan](link_20), [Ozzy Osbourne](link_21), and [Robert Plant](link_22) are his main inspirations.

According to his official website, the first two albums he ever bought were [Deep Purple](link_23)'s _Fireball_ and [Black Sabbath](link_24)'s _Master of Reality_.

## Personal Beliefs

King Diamond follows a philosophy that he does not see as a religion. He believes that religion has caused a lot of conflict and destruction throughout history. He finds it difficult to understand why people fight over beliefs that cannot be proven. He has stated that he no longer believes in anything religious.

## Family Life

King Diamond is married to Livia Zita, a singer from Hungary. She has sung backup vocals on his albums _The Puppet Master_ and _Give Me Your Soul...Please_, and also performs live with him. She is also his business partner.

As of 2025, she is working with him to gather old video footage for two upcoming DVD releases of King Diamond and Mercyful Fate live shows. She also helped create updated versions of King Diamond's albums, including _The Spider's Lullabye_, _The Graveyard_, _Voodoo_, and _House of God_.

In March 2017, King Diamond and Livia Zita became parents to a son named Byron.

## Influence on Other Artists

Metallica released an 11-minute mix of five Mercyful Fate songs on their 1998 cover album _Garage Inc._. King Diamond has joined Metallica on stage three times to perform this medley: at the 1999 Gods of Metal festival in Italy, at the 2008 Ozzfest in Texas, and at a 2011 Metallica fan club show in California. For the 1999 and 2011 performances, Hank Shermann also joined on guitar.

King Diamond has been featured on the covers of many rock and metal magazines. He has influenced many artists, including [Metallica](link_6)'s [Lars Ulrich](link_25), Cradle of Filth, and Cage.

The American heavy metal band Cage dedicated a song to him called "King Diamond" on their 2007 album _Hell Destroyer_.

## Awards and Nominations

*   2008 – [Grammy nomination](link_10) for "Best Metal Performance" for the song "Never Ending Hill."

Musical artist

**Kim Bendix Petersen** (born 14 June 1956),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-bio-1) better known by his stage name **King Diamond**, is a Danish rock musician. As a vocalist, he is known for his powerful and wide-ranging [countertenor](link_9) singing voice, in particular his far-reaching [falsetto](link_10) screams. He is the lead vocalist and lyricist for both [Mercyful Fate](link_7) and the eponymous [King Diamond](link_2). He also plays keyboards and guitars on studio recordings but uses live shows to focus solely on his vocal performance. Diamond is renowned for his dark lyrical content and his story concepts. He is also known for his distinctive [shock](link_6) stage persona (in particular his black and white facepaint). He has been an influence for other rock and metal artists, including [Metallica](link_11),[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-auto-3)[Slayer](link_12)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-Metal_Hammer-4) and [Cradle of Filth](link_13).[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-auto1-5).

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Career")]

### Early days

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Early days")]

Kim Petersen was born in [Hvidovre](link_4), a suburb of [Copenhagen](link_14), [Denmark](link_15) on June 14, 1956. His father worked as a foreman at a storage facility, while his mother was secretary to the city's mayor. He grew up alongside his younger brother Stig. He revealed that growing up there was strict discipline in the way he and his brother were raised but lived a "very normal childhood." Petersen first became curious about occultism after listening to [Black Sabbath](link_16) and reading about [Jimmy Page's](link_17) interest in [Aleister Crowley](link_18). These interests eventually led to him reading the work of [Anton LaVey](link_19).[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-6)

He attended basic school for 10 years and then attended college, where studied to become a lab assistant. By this time he was playing music but mostly as a hobby.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:2-7)

King Diamond's first [heavy rock](link_5) band was called Brainstorm (1974–76), with Jeanette Blum (Jean Blue) on vocals and bass, Michael Frohn (Mike West) on guitar and Jes Jacobsen (Jesse James) on drums. Diamond left Brainstorm and began singing with local Danish [hard rock](link_20) band Black Rose. He began experimenting with [horror](link_21)-themed theatrics and shaping a malevolent quasi-[Satanic](link_22) stage persona. He left Black Rose and joined the [punk](link_23)-[metal](link_5) band Brats, where he met [Hank Shermann](link_24). The two were soon asked to help Michael Denner (also formerly a member of Brats) with his own project, Danger Zone. This band included [Timi Hansen](link_25), and the musicians would join with Diamond in 1980 to become [Mercyful Fate](link_7).

### Mercyful Fate

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Mercyful Fate")]

Main article: [Mercyful Fate](link_7)

When Diamond first started Mercyful Fate, the band was not making much money and was taking up a lot of his time. Eventually, he decided to quit his job and live off of [social security](link_26) in order to focus on the band. Not long afterward, however, Mercyful Fate began to take off.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:2-7)

Following Mercyful Fate's 1984 release of _[Don't Break the Oath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don [link_27]'t\_Break\_the\_Oath "Don't Break the Oath")_ and the subsequent tour (which saw them play in the U.S. for the first time), Diamond split ways with Mercyful Fate. With him, he took two of his bandmates (Hansen and Denner) to pursue a solo career under his own name.

Mercyful Fate reunited in 1992 (while Diamond simultaneously continued his solo career) and recorded five more studio albums. In 1999, Diamond and Hank Shermann performed the song "Evil" live with [Metallica](link_11). This performance also featured Diamond without his famous makeup.

**King Diamond** es el nombre artístico del músico danés **Kim Bendix Petersen** (nacido en [Copenhague](link_4), el 14 de junio de 1956). King Diamond también es el nombre de su proyecto musical más conocido. En este proyecto, él es el cantante principal y el compositor. La revista _Hit Parader_ lo incluyó en su lista de los 100 mejores vocalistas de metal del mundo.

## Contenido

*   [King Diamond: Un Músico Único](https://ninos.kiddle.co/King_Diamond#King_Diamond:_Un_M.C3.BAsico_.C3.9Anico)

## King Diamond: Un Músico Único

King Diamond es conocido por su estilo musical y su puesta en escena. Ha creado una carrera destacada en el mundo del [heavy metal](link_13). Su música y sus presentaciones en vivo son muy especiales.

### Inicios y Proyectos Musicales

King Diamond comenzó su carrera musical con la banda Black Rose en 1979. Esta banda tenía influencias del [rock psicodélico](link_18) y el [hard rock](link_19).

En 1981, formó la banda Mercyful Fate. Este fue su primer gran proyecto. En Mercyful Fate, mezcló un estilo de heavy metal complejo con letras que exploraban temas oscuros.

Finalmente, en 1985, creó su proyecto solista llamado King Diamond. Este proyecto ha estado activo desde entonces. También participó en otras bandas como Brats y Danger Zone. En 2004, colaboró con [Dave Grohl](link_20) en la canción "Sweet Dreams" para el álbum _Probot_.

### Su Carrera como Solista

Como solista, King Diamond desarrolló un sonido más teatral y progresivo. Mantuvo la energía y los cambios de ritmo de Mercyful Fate. En sus álbumes, King Diamond suele contar historias de horror que él mismo escribe.

Sus álbumes son a menudo álbumes conceptuales. Esto significa que todas las canciones cuentan una misma historia. La historia del álbum _Abigail_ es una de las más famosas. Este álbum es muy querido por sus seguidores y ha recibido excelentes críticas.

#### El Estilo Musical y Vocal

La voz de King Diamond es muy particular. Usa cambios repentinos en el tono y a menudo canta en [falsete](link_21). Su maquillaje llamativo y sus historias lo hacen único.

Aunque su falsete es muy conocido, King Diamond tiene una técnica vocal muy amplia. Puede usar diferentes tipos de voz y transmitir muchas emociones. Esto se nota tanto en sus grabaciones como en sus conciertos.

La colaboración de Andy LaRocque ha sido muy importante para el sonido de King Diamond. Andy es el guitarrista y ha ayudado a escribir muchas canciones. Sus solos y [riffs](link_22) (melodías de guitarra) son una parte clave del sonido de la banda. Andy LaRocque es el único miembro original que ha estado con King Diamond desde 1985.

#### La Puesta en Escena

King Diamond es famoso por sus presentaciones en vivo. En ellas, representa las historias de horror de sus álbumes. Es como ver una obra de teatro con música.

Actualmente, la banda cuenta con una actriz, Jody Cachia. Ella interpreta a diferentes personajes de las historias de King Diamond en los conciertos. Esto hace que los shows sean aún más especiales y envolventes.

### Su Maquillaje Característico

[![Image 5: Archivo:Tuska 20130628 - King Diamond - 05](https://ninos.kiddle.co/images/thumb/b/b5/Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_05.jpg/200px-Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_05.jpg)](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_05.jpg)

[](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_05.jpg "Aumentar")

 King Diamond en una presentación en el Tuska Open Air Metal Festival (2013).

Desde sus inicios con Mercyful Fate, King Diamond ha usado un maquillaje facial muy distintivo, conocido como _corpsepaint_. Ha cambiado su estilo de maquillaje varias veces a lo largo de su carrera. Él ha mencionado que se inspiró en el maquillaje que usaba [Alice Cooper](link_23) en el escenario.

Al principio de los años ochenta, King Diamond recibió una carta de [Gene Simmons](link_24) de la banda [Kiss](link_25). En la carta, se le acusaba de haber copiado su maquillaje. Aunque no hubo una demanda formal, King Diamond decidió cambiar su estilo. Poco después, apareció con un maquillaje diferente y más original.

### Influencia en la Música

King Diamond ha ganado muchos seguidores en el mundo del metal. Ha influido en bandas muy populares como [Metallica](link_26). Su impacto se sintió primero en los países escandinavos y luego en Estados Unidos y Europa.

Desde el lanzamiento del álbum _Melissa_ de Mercyful Fate en 1983, King Diamond es considerado un artista de culto. Algunos lo ven como un pionero del black metal, aunque esto es un tema de debate. Su sonido es más cercano al heavy metal tradicional y al speed metal. Sin embargo, sus letras y su estilo oscuro han sido una inspiración para muchas bandas.

King Diamond es un gran admirador de la banda Uriah Heep. La canción "The Wizard" de Uriah Heep se usa como introducción en sus conciertos de _Abigail_. En honor al vocalista de Uriah Heep, David Byron, su hijo se llama Byron.

### Vida Personal

Kim Bendix Petersen está casado con Livia Zita, una cantante de origen húngaro. La pareja vive en [Dallas](link_27), [Texas](link_28), [Estados Unidos](link_29).

Livia Zita ha participado como vocalista de apoyo en los álbumes _The Puppet Master_ y _Give Me Your Soul...Please_. También ha cantado en sus conciertos en vivo.

Además, Livia es su socia en los negocios musicales. Trabaja con él para organizar material antiguo de King Diamond y Mercyful Fate para futuros lanzamientos en DVD. También ha colaborado en la remasterización de varios de sus discos. En 2018, Livia y Kim tuvieron a su primer hijo, a quien llamaron Byron.

### Discografía Destacada

Aquí tienes algunos de los álbumes más conocidos de King Diamond:

*   1986: _Fatal Portrait_
*   1987: _Abigail_
*   1988: _Them_
*   1989: _Conspiracy_
*   1990: _The Eye_
*   1995: _The Spider's Lullabye_
*   1996: _The Graveyard_
*   1998: _Voodoo_
*   2000: _House of God_
*   2002: _Abigail II: The Revenge_
*   2003: _The Puppet Master_
*   2007: _Give Me Your Soul...Please_
*   2019: _songs for the dead live_

**Mercyful Fate** is a Danish [heavy metal](link_5) band from [Copenhagen](link_4), formed in 1981 by vocalist [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond") and guitarist [Hank Shermann](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann "Hank Shermann").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-shermann_bio-2) Influenced by [progressive rock](link_17) and [hard rock](link_18), and with lyrics dealing with [LaVeyan Satanism](link_19) (often with [ironic](link_20) or [sardonic](link_21) use of [Christian](link_22) themes) and the [occult](link_23), Mercyful Fate was part of the [first wave of black metal](link_6) in the early to mid-1980s, along with [Venom](link_24) and [Bathory](link_25).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-4) The band is also cited as a formative influence to the then-nascent genres of [thrash metal](link_26)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-Kerry_King-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-metalinjection-6) and [death metal](link_27), as well as the [Norwegian black metal](link_28) scene.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate#cite_note-Melissa_Review-9)

Since its inception in 1981, Mercyful Fate has released seven studio albums, two [extended plays](link_29), and four [compilation albums](link_30). After several line-up changes and self-made demos, they released their [self-titled EP](link_31) in 1982, with the line-up of [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond") (vocals), Hank Shermann (lead and rhythm guitars), Michael Denner (rhythm and lead guitars), [Timi Hansen](link_11) (bass), and Kim Ruzz (drums). With this line-up, the group recorded its first two studio albums: 1983's _[Melissa](link_32)_ and 1984's _[Don't Break the Oath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don [link_33]'t\_Break\_the\_Oath "Don't Break the Oath")_. Musical artist

**René Krolmark** (born 11 July 1958), better known by his stage name, **Hank Shermann**, is a Danish musician best known for his work with the heavy metal band [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate").

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hank_Shermann&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Career")]

Shermann started playing guitar in 1977, influenced by the likes of [Ace Frehley](link_7), [Michael Schenker](link_8), [Uli Roth](link_9), [K.K. Downing](link_10) and [Glenn Tipton](link_11).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto1-1) In 1978 he co-founded and performed with the Danish [punk](link_12) band [Brats](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brats_(Punk_band)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Brats (Punk band) (page does not exist)") (under the name Hank de Wank), where he first met future bandmates [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond") and later [Michael Denner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Denner?action=edit&redlink=1 "Michael Denner (page does not exist)"). The band released one album and was dissolved in 1981 after a disagreement with their record label.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-2)

In 1981 he formed [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate") alongside [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond"), where they deviated from punk music and started to write heavier songs. During this time Shermann composed all the music for 1983's [_Melissa_](link_22) and most of 1984's _[Don't Break the Oath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don [link_13]'t\_Break\_the\_Oath "Don't Break the Oath")_, widely considered Mercyful Fate's most seminal albums. Mercyful Fate disbanded in 1985 due to creative differences, as Shermann wanted to create a more commercial approach.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-3)

Shermann formed and performed in the [arena rock](link_14) band [Fate](link_15) from 1984-1988, while King Diamond formed the eponymous [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") alongside Mercyful Fate members Michael Denner and Timi Hansen.

In 1992 Mercyful Fate reformed with four of the five original members, and after several lineup changes the group released five albums before going on hiatus in 1999. In 2002 Shermann and Denner formed the band Force of Evil and two albums were released.

In 2008 Shermann formed the band Demonica with Klaus Hyr, and released a single album before disbanding. In 2012 Shermann toured with [Volbeat](link_16) for 74 shows across North America, Europe and South America when they were supporting [Megadeth](link_17).[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-4) In 2014 he teamed up with his old bandmate Michael Denner to form Denner/Shermann, before the two disbanded in 2018.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto1-1)

Mercyful Fate reformed once again in 2019 and were planning to tour North America and Europe (however this has been delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic),[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto3-5) with plans to release their first album in over two decades.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto3-5)

Shermann released his first solo single in 2019, and plans to release a full album in 2022.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto1-1)

## Equipment

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hank_Shermann&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Equipment")]

Shermann's first guitar was a black Japanese [Les Paul](link_18) copy he bought for US$100.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-auto1-1) Shermann often tours with [Gibson Flying Vs](link_19) and Fender [Stratocasters](link_20).

A signature Flying V was created for Shermann by 10-32 Guitars. The "HSV" features 27 frets and tremolo bar.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann#cite_note-6)

The **[white-headed fruit dove](link_39)** (_Ptilinopus eugeniae_) is a species of bird in the pigeon family, [Columbidae](link_23). It was [described](link_24) by [John Gould](link_25) in 1856, and the [specific name](link_26)_eugeniae_ honours [Eugénie de Montijo](link_27). Adults of the species have white heads, a purplish-red breast patch, a grey shoulder patch, olive-green [upperparts](link_28), greenish [underparts](link_28) with a blue tinge, and a yellowish [vent](link_28). Juveniles have green heads with the white restricted to the forehead and upper throat, a much smaller grey shoulder patch, and the red breast patch restricted to the centre of the breast. The species is [endemic](link_29) to [Makira](link_30) and the nearby islands of [Ugi](link_31) and [Malaupaina](link_32) in the Solomon Islands. It inhabits lowland, hill, and ridge forest, along with neighbouring agricultural areas, and is especially common in [foothills](link_33). Its diet consists of small-seeded fruits and berries. The [IUCN](link_34) considers it a [least-concern species](link_35). Although it can adapt to [disturbed habitat](link_36), it is threatened by [deforestation](link_37) and [habitat loss](link_38). _(**[Full article...](link_39)**)_

## M ind-blowing F acts

[![Image 5: Pillars of creation 2014 HST WFC3-UVIS full-res denoised](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/6/68/Pillars_of_creation_2014_HST_WFC3-UVIS_full-res_denoised.jpg/300px-Pillars_of_creation_2014_HST_WFC3-UVIS_full-res_denoised.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Pillars_of_creation_2014_HST_WFC3-UVIS_full-res_denoised.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Pillars_of_creation_2014_HST_WFC3-UVIS_full-res_denoised.jpg "Enlarge")

 The Pillars of Creation in the [Eagle Nebula](link_35), one of the most famous space photographs in history taken by the Hubble Space Telescope.

**When the [Hubble Space Telescope](link_36) first opened its robotic eyes in 1990, scientists were shocked to see that every picture came out blurry.**

What had gone wrong? Hubble's giant main mirror had been polished into the wrong shape by a mistake smaller than 1/50th the thickness of a human hair! That tiny error was too small to see, but it was big enough to keep light from focusing correctly.

 Thankfully, astronomers and engineers did not give up. In December 1993, a brave crew of astronauts flew into space aboard the [Space Shuttle Endeavour](link_37) on a daring repair mission. During five intense spacewalks, they installed a special tool called COSTAR, which stands for Corrective Optics Space Telescope Axial Replacement. COSTAR worked like a pair of high-tech eyeglasses for Hubble, fixing its blurry vision. When Hubble looked back at the stars, everything was perfectly clear!

Danish heavy metal band

| Background information |
| Origin | [Copenhagen](link_3), Denmark |

**King Diamond** is a Danish [heavy metal](link_4) band formed in 1985 by vocalist [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond"), guitarists [Andy LaRocque](link_13) and Michael Denner, bassist [Timi Hansen](link_14), and drummer [Mikkey Dee](link_15). King, Denner and Hansen had recently disbanded [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate"), and formed a new band under the King Diamond moniker, already known from the initial Mercyful Fate era.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-YouTube_#1-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Music_Box-2) Since the band's inception, there have been over fifteen musicians in and out of King Diamond, with Diamond as the only remaining original member, while LaRocque remained until 2026. Their current line-up consists of Diamond, guitarist [Mike Wead](link_9), drummer Matt Thompson, bassist Pontus Egberg and guitarist [Gus G](link_10) as LaRocque's replacement.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Band_members-4)

King Diamond has released twelve [studio albums](link_16) (most of them [concept albums](link_17)), two [live albums](link_18), two [extended plays](link_19), five [compilation albums](link_20), and five [singles](link_21). Their first album, _[Fatal Portrait](link_22)_, was released in 1986, followed a year later by the band's first concept album, _[Abigail](link_23)_ (1987). Three more albums followed – _["Them"](link_24)_ (1988), _[Conspiracy](link_25)_ (1989), and _[The Eye](link_26)_ (1990) – before the band went on hiatus around 1992, when King Diamond, Denner, and Hansen reformed Mercyful Fate.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Band_members-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Allmusic-5) He reformed the King Diamond band in 1994, and balanced recording and touring with Mercyful Fate and his eponymous band for nearly a decade, until the former went on hiatus again by the early 2000s. King Diamond's studio output has been minimal since 2007's _[Give Me Your Soul...Please](link_27)_, though the band has continued to perform live and occasionally teased more than one upcoming album.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Spider_Lily-6)

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond_(band)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

### Formation, _Fatal Portrait_ and _Abigail_ (1985–1987)

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond_(band)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Formation, Fatal Portrait and Abigail (1985–1987)")]

Vocalist [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond"), guitarist Michael Denner, and bassist [Timi Hansen](link_14) formed the band in 1985.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-YouTube_#1-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Music_Box-2) The three had recently departed [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate") due to musical differences between Diamond and guitarist [Hank Shermann](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann "Hank Shermann").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-YouTube_#1-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Music_Box-2)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Allmusic-5) According to Diamond, when he, Denner, and Hansen formed a new band, they chose the name "King Diamond" to "get better deals", and because the name was already known from Mercyful Fate.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-YouTube_#1-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Music_Box-2) To round out the line-up, the group hired Swedish musicians [Mikkey Dee](link_15) on drums and guitarist Floyd Konstantin, the latter of whom was dismissed two weeks before recording the debut album,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-7) and replaced by Swedish musician [Andy LaRocque](link_13).[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Band_members-4)

In July 1985, the band began recording their debut album at Sound Track Studio in [Copenhagen](link_3).[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Fatal_Portrait-8) On 25 December, they released debut single "No Presents for Christmas".[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-No_Presents_for_Christmas-9)_[Fatal Portrait](link_22)_, the band's first full-length studio album, was released on 14 March 1986,[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-10) through [Roadrunner Records](link_6).[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Fatal_Portrait-8) Produced by Rune Höyer and Diamond, the album charted at number 33 on the Swedish album chart,[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band)#cite_note-Fatal_SWE-11) and spawned the single "Halloween", released on 6 June 1986.[[12]](

URL Source: https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework

Markdown Content:
[![Image 1: kids encyclopedia robot](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/wk/kids-robot.svg)](https://www.kiddle.co/)[![Image 2: kids search engine](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/wk/kids_search_engine.svg)](https://www.kiddle.co/) Clear Search * [Web](https://www.kiddle.co/) * [Images](https://www.kiddle.co/images.php) * [Kimages](https://www.kiddle.co/kimages.php) * [Kpedia](https://kids.kiddle.co/) * [Español](https://es.kiddle.co/)

# Homework facts for kids

[Kids Encyclopedia Facts](https://kids.kiddle.co/)

[![Image 3: Child calculating with fingers](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/5/51/Child_calculating_with_fingers.jpg/300px-Child_calculating_with_fingers.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Child_calculating_with_fingers.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Child_calculating_with_fingers.jpg "Enlarge")

 Homework

**Homework** is school work that students are given by their teachers to do at home. It's like practice that helps students remember what they learned in class. It also helps them review topics.

The amount of homework students get can be different. It usually depends on how old they are and what grade they are in. Older students often get more homework than younger ones.

[![Image 4: Homework - vector maths](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/1/15/Homework_-_vector_maths.jpg/300px-Homework_-_vector_maths.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Homework_-_vector_maths.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Homework_-_vector_maths.jpg "Enlarge")

 Homework can include math problems

Teachers give homework for many reasons, including:

*   **Practice:** To help you practice what you learned.
*   **Preparation:** To get you ready for new topics.
*   **Participation:** To involve you more in your learning.
*   **Personal development:** To help you grow and learn on your own.
*   **Parent–child relations:** To give parents a chance to see what you're learning.
*   **Parent–teacher communications:** To help teachers and parents talk about your progress.
*   **Peer interactions:** Sometimes, homework involves working with classmates.

Homework can also help you learn how to be organized. It teaches you to work on tasks by yourself. It can also improve your time management and focus skills.

## Contents

*   [How Homework Affects Students](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#How_Homework_Affects_Students)
    *   [School Performance](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#School_Performance)
    *   [Other Effects](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#Other_Effects)

*   [A Look Back: The History of Homework](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#A_Look_Back:_The_History_of_Homework)
    *   [In the United States](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#In_the_United_States)
    *   [In the United Kingdom](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#In_the_United_Kingdom)
    *   [In Spain](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#In_Spain)

*   [Images for kids](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#Images_for_kids)
*   [See also](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework#See_also)

## How Homework Affects Students

### School Performance

[![Image 5: L’éducation](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/b/be/L%E2%80%99%C3%A9ducation.jpg/300px-L%E2%80%99%C3%A9ducation.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:L%E2%80%99%C3%A9ducation.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:L%E2%80%99%C3%A9ducation.jpg "Enlarge")

 A child in Senegal doing homework

People have different ideas about whether homework really helps students do better in school. What studies show can change based on things like the students' age and how "academic performance" is measured.

Some studies suggest that homework doesn't always improve grades for younger students in elementary school. However, some people who support homework say it helps kids learn good study habits. But there isn't much research to prove this idea.

For teenagers, spending more time on homework often leads to higher grades and better test scores. But there's a limit! Studies have shown that if teenagers spend more than 90 minutes a day on homework, their school performance can actually get worse.

Interestingly, students who are struggling in school often benefit more from doing homework than those who are already doing well. However, teachers sometimes give less homework to students who need it most. They might give more homework to students who are already performing well. In the past, homework could even make students drop out of school. If they couldn't keep up with the work, they might just quit.

### Other Effects

The amount of homework you get doesn't always change how you feel about homework or school in general.

Some research suggests that homework can help students become more motivated and improve their study skills. In one study, parents and teachers thought homework helped middle school students learn to be responsible. However, the students themselves often felt negatively about homework. They were less likely to think it helped them develop these skills. Other studies found that students often felt negative emotions when doing homework. They were also less engaged compared to other activities.

## A Look Back: The History of Homework

[![Image 6: Homework in Japan, Taisho era (1915 by Elstner Hilton)](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/8/8e/Homework_in_Japan%2C_Taisho_era_%281915_by_Elstner_Hilton%29.jpg/300px-Homework_in_Japan%2C_Taisho_era_%281915_by_Elstner_Hilton%29.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Homework_in_Japan,_Taisho_era_(1915_by_Elstner_Hilton).jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Homework_in_Japan,_Taisho_era_(1915_by_Elstner_Hilton).jpg "Enlarge")

 Japanese students doing homework, around 1915

[![Image 7: Yrjö Ollila - Hearing the Homework](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/f/f9/Yrj%C3%B6_Ollila_-_Hearing_the_Homework.jpg/300px-Yrj%C3%B6_Ollila_-_Hearing_the_Homework.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Yrj%C3%B6_Ollila_-_Hearing_the_Homework.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Yrj%C3%B6_Ollila_-_Hearing_the_Homework.jpg "Enlarge")

_Hearing the Homework_; a painting by Yrjö Ollila

### In the United States

For a long time, many people in the United States didn't like homework. Not many students went on to college back then. Also, many children and teenagers had to spend a lot of time doing chores or farm work. So, homework was unpopular with both parents and some schools. If students couldn't keep up with homework, which often meant memorizing texts at home, they might drop out of school early. Going to school wasn't always required by law.

Parents often complained about homework. In 1880, a man named Francis Amasa Walker convinced the school board in Boston to stop teachers from giving math homework. In 1900, a journalist named Edward Bok argued against giving homework to students under 15. He told parents to send notes to teachers demanding an end to homework, and thousands did! People also pointed out that school time plus homework could be more hours than a child was allowed to work for pay under new child labor laws. This led to experts telling the US Congress that children should never have homework. They also said teenagers should have no more than two hours of homework a day. In 1901, California even passed a law that basically got rid of homework for anyone under 15.

While homework wasn't popular in the first half of the 1900s, some people wanted to change it instead of banning it. They thought homework should be more connected to students' real lives outside of school.

In the 1950s, homework became popular again. This was because the United States wanted to stay ahead during the Cold War. Children were encouraged to keep up with students in the Soviet Union. Since then, attitudes about homework have changed every 15 years or so. It was popular from the 1950s to mid-1960s, then less popular until 1980. It became popular again from 1980 until the mid-1990s, when the Cold War ended. After the Cold War, homework became less favored again.

### In the United Kingdom

Students in the United Kingdom tend to get more homework than many other countries in Europe. On average, they spend about 5 hours a week on homework. There's also a difference in the UK based on social class. Middle-class teenagers often get a lot more homework compared to students in Asia and other parts of Europe.

### In Spain

In 2012, a report showed that children in Spain spend about 6.4 hours a week on homework.

*   [![Image 9: Boy doing homework (4596604619)](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/6/6e/Boy_doing_homework_%284596604619%29.jpg/120px-Boy_doing_homework_%284596604619%29.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Boy_doing_homework_(4596604619).jpg)  A child completing their homework  
*   [![Image 10: This is a stupid way to write a paper](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/8/83/This_is_a_stupid_way_to_write_a_paper.jpg/90px-This_is_a_stupid_way_to_write_a_paper.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:This_is_a_stupid_way_to_write_a_paper.jpg)  Homework can take up a lot of a student's free time. It can sometimes lead to stress, sadness, anger, and trouble sleeping for kids. It can also cause arguments in families.

URL Source: https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico

Markdown Content:

# Músico para niños

[Enciclopedia para niños](https://ninos.kiddle.co/)

No debe confundirse con [Música](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsica "Música").

[![Image 3: Archivo:US Navy 091207-N-7498L-511 Musician Kristen Snitzer, assigned to the U.S. Pacific Fleet Navy Band, performs](https://ninos.kiddle.co/images/thumb/7/77/US_Navy_091207-N-7498L-511_Musician_Kristen_Snitzer%2C_assigned_to_the_U.S._Pacific_Fleet_Navy_Band%2C_performs.jpg/300px-US_Navy_091207-N-7498L-511_Musician_Kristen_Snitzer%2C_assigned_to_the_U.S._Pacific_Fleet_Navy_Band%2C_performs.jpg)](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:US_Navy_091207-N-7498L-511_Musician_Kristen_Snitzer,_assigned_to_the_U.S._Pacific_Fleet_Navy_Band,_performs.jpg)

[](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:US_Navy_091207-N-7498L-511_Musician_Kristen_Snitzer,_assigned_to_the_U.S._Pacific_Fleet_Navy_Band,_performs.jpg "Aumentar")

 Marinera músico tocando la corneta.

Un **músico** es una persona que crea o interpreta música. Esto puede ser tocando un [instrumento musical](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Instrumento_musical "Instrumento musical"), cantando con su propia voz, o haciendo ambas cosas. Cualquiera que compone, dirige o toca música es considerado un músico. A quienes tocan un instrumento también se les llama ejecutantes o instrumentistas.

Los músicos pueden especializarse en muchos tipos de música, como el rock, el pop, la música clásica o el jazz. Algunos incluso tocan varios estilos diferentes, dependiendo de su cultura o de cómo aprendieron. Las actividades que un músico puede hacer son muchas, por ejemplo: tocar en vivo, dirigir una orquesta, cantar, crear música en el momento (improvisar), escribir canciones (componer), adaptar canciones para diferentes instrumentos (arreglos), organizar la música para una orquesta (orquestación) y supervisar la grabación de canciones (producción musical).

A veces, de forma despectiva, se usa la palabra "musicastro" para referirse a un músico, pero no es un término común ni respetuoso.

## Contenido

*   [¿Qué tipos de músicos existen?](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#.C2.BFQu.C3.A9_tipos_de_m.C3.BAsicos_existen.3F)
    *   [Músicos con formación académica](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#M.C3.BAsicos_con_formaci.C3.B3n_acad.C3.A9mica)
    *   [Músicos autodidactas o empíricos](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#M.C3.BAsicos_autodidactas_o_emp.C3.ADricos)

*   [¿Cuándo se celebra el Día del Músico?](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#.C2.BFCu.C3.A1ndo_se_celebra_el_D.C3.ADa_del_M.C3.BAsico.3F)
*   [Galería de imágenes](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#Galer.C3.ADa_de_im.C3.A1genes)
*   [Ver también](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#Ver_tambi.C3.A9n)
*   [Véase también](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%BAsico#V.C3.A9ase_tambi.C3.A9n)

## ¿Qué tipos de músicos existen?

Existen diferentes maneras en que las personas se convierten en músicos. Aquí te explicamos las dos principales:

### Músicos con formación académica

[![Image 4: Archivo:Sebastian Knauer](https://ninos.kiddle.co/images/thumb/e/e7/Sebastian_Knauer.jpg/300px-Sebastian_Knauer.jpg)](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Sebastian_Knauer.jpg)

[](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Sebastian_Knauer.jpg "Aumentar")

 Músico tocando el piano.

Estos son los músicos que han estudiado música de forma oficial. Han asistido a lugares como conservatorios, universidades, institutos o academias de música. Su formación les permite trabajar en diversas áreas, como:

*   **Directores de orquesta:** Son quienes guían a un grupo de músicos para que toquen juntos.
*   **Compositores:** Crean nuevas piezas musicales.
*   **Instrumentistas:** Son expertos en tocar un instrumento específico, como pianistas, violinistas, flautistas, guitarristas clásicos, entre otros.
*   **Licenciados en música:** Personas con un título universitario en música.
*   **Profesores de música:** Enseñan a otros a tocar instrumentos o a entender la música.
*   **Críticos musicales:** Analizan y opinan sobre la música, pero no son periodistas de chismes.
*   **Musicólogos:** Estudian la historia y la teoría de la música.
*   **Etnomusicólogos:** Investigan la música de diferentes culturas del mundo.

### Músicos autodidactas o empíricos

[![Image 5: Archivo:Quito Accordion player](https://ninos.kiddle.co/images/thumb/0/0a/Quito_Accordion_player.jpg/300px-Quito_Accordion_player.jpg)](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Quito_Accordion_player.jpg)

[](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Archivo:Quito_Accordion_player.jpg "Aumentar")

 Músico ciego ejecutando el acordeón.

Estos músicos aprenden a tocar y componer por sí mismos, sin ir a una escuela formal de música. A veces se les llama músicos aficionados, pero es importante no confundirlos con aquellos que, aunque tienen formación, tocan por gusto y no por dinero. Muchos músicos autodidactas tocan un instrumento para ganarse la vida.

## ¿Cuándo se celebra el Día del Músico?

Para las personas católicas, [Santa Cecilia](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Cecilia_de_Roma "Cecilia de Roma") es considerada la patrona de la música. Esto fue establecido por el papa [Gregorio XIII](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Gregorio_XIII "Gregorio XIII") en el año 1594. El día de su fiesta se celebra el 22 de noviembre, que es la fecha en que ella falleció. Por eso, el 22 de noviembre se ha convertido en el Día del Músico en muchos lugares.

Title: Muse — Your Personal AI Agent

URL Source: https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https://muse.ai/&h=AUCJdqIvg8yzh1rlIToWDd3XXWte_YUV55FcUCs1MVAmU8Dlcy4VceVEQwwCJblc1j2d0a1-rppZmEmPhLxOpLOVK4s0e1FEW_FHYzi_A0vDXPBM219bbS9Ewb9huwrQ_jPxIaiVc7Hvhg

Markdown Content:
Log in

![Image 1: Muse](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/brand/muse-logo.svg)
# Muse, AI that gets it done for you Muse[Video 1](https://l.facebook.com/videos/avatars/hatch_connecting.mp4)[Video 2](https://l.facebook.com/videos/avatars/hatch_working.mp4), AI that gets it done for you sorts your email books reservations shops for you saves you money manages calendars builds fitness plans gets it done for you sorts your email![Image 2](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-envelope.webp)books reservations![Image 3](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-airplane.webp)shops for you![Image 4](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-cart.webp)saves you money![Image 5](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-piggybank.webp)manages calendars![Image 6](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/icon-calendar.webp)builds fitness plans![Image 7](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/icons/b-01.webp)gets it done for you

# Log in or create an account

Mobile number or email(required) 

You may receive SMS notifications from us by using your mobile number. [Learn more](https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/31983416211257755/)

Continue

[Learn more](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https://muse.ai/&h=AUCJdqIvg8yzh1rlIToWDd3XXWte_YUV55FcUCs1MVAmU8Dlcy4VceVEQwwCJblc1j2d0a1-rppZmEmPhLxOpLOVK4s0e1FEW_FHYzi_A0vDXPBM219bbS9Ewb9huwrQ_jPxIaiVc7Hvhg#landing-introduction-video-title)

## Built around your whole life

Give Muse a goal or task and it handles the rest, from saving money and improving your health to smart shopping and helping you strengthen your relationships.

[Video 3](https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/o1/v/t6/f2/m421/AQPvdntV2G814fVexG62mHy9MLAFz-IUx2_276pwlTOScjlG7403bT1NxrxgW2yToPZR5BOsHoRWgC3EQGGX.mp4?_nc_sid=9c7e41&_nc_ht=scontent.xx.fbcdn.net&ccb=17-1&_nc_gid=RnhA5CRLhEnYfmt-YXr3ww&edm=AIlawRcEAAAA&_nc_zt=28&oh=00_AQM1YmFN7AOTSTR_gyGHhEAsA1HVo9hP8ktbuuBhTh1RVQ&oe=6AEB006E#t=1)

### Every Muse user shares their own computer in the cloud with their Muse.

Muse Secure VM is a persistent, isolated Linux computer with a full browser that you and your agent can use to complete tasks, allowing you to intervene at any point. It's your computer and your browser, with the storage, CPU, and memory to handle real work.

![Image 8: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/browser.webp)![Image 9: Floating browser, search, map, calendar, and confirmation panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/browser-dark.webp)

### Designed around the way you already communicate

Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp. There's no learning curve, just tell Muse what you want to get done.

![Image 10: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/messaging.webp)![Image 11: A chat on a phone where the agent has filled out a school form, shown beside a laptop](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/messaging-dark.webp)

### Stay in control of what your agent does

Approve actions your agent takes on your behalf before they happen, like sending emails and making purchases. See a complete audit trail of everything your agent has done (and what it's planning to do).

![Image 12: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/approvals.webp)![Image 13: Floating purchase, message, activity, permission, and decision controls](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/approvals-dark.webp)

### Your data is kept secure and private

Save your logins to a secure credential store Muse can't see, with 1Password integration coming soon. When shopping, a one-time card number is generated at checkout so your real card stays hidden from the merchant and your agent. Eligible purchases are covered by [Link's purchase protections](https://link.com/protections), a first for AI agents, and your conversations are not shared with Meta's ad systems.

![Image 14: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/secure-storage.webp)![Image 15: A vault, privacy shield, masked credential, security control, and virtual card](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/secure-storage-dark.webp)

### Proactively helps with your goals and suggests ideas

Muse helps you stay on top of things, takes tasks and projects off your plate, and turns long-term goals into real progress. It learns from conversations, reflects on what matters and gets sharper, coming back with ideas built around what you actually need, ready to act on them under your direction.

![Image 16: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/goals.webp)![Image 17: Floating checklist, calendar, route, progress, and idea panels](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/goals-dark.webp)

### Connects to your apps and builds its own tools

Connect the apps you use daily, like email, calendar, and Instagram. You decide what your agent can see and what it can do. If a task needs a tool that doesn't exist, your agent builds it for you.

![Image 18: Connected app, messaging, media, cloud, calendar, and automation tiles](https://l.facebook.com/images/landing/connectors.webp)

## Get the most out of your Muse

A guided tour of Muse, from setting a first goal to seeing it through.

![Image 19: Product designer presenting a guided tour of Muse](https://l.facebook.com/images/hatch/landing/product-walkthrough-cover.png)

## Learn more about Muse

Explore the choices behind Muse and how it is built to deserve your trust.

### [How We Designed Muse When Muse works, it feels like magic. These are the product choices that make the experience possible.](https://introducing.muse.ai/)### [How We Built Safety Into Muse Muse is built for privacy, safety, and security. Learn how these principles shape every part of the product.](https://security.muse.ai/)### [Muse for Business Meet the AI agent that works for your small business and keeps jobs moving between your decisions.](https://l.facebook.com/business)

## Ready to try Muse?

[King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") is a Danish [heavy metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") band from [Copenhagen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen "Copenhagen"). Formed in 1985 by vocalist [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond "King Diamond"), guitarist Michael Denner, and bassist [Timi Hansen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen "Timi Hansen") after the breakup of their former band [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate"). The first lineup of the group also included guitarist [Andy LaRocque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque "Andy LaRocque") and drummer [Mikkey Dee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikkey_Dee "Mikkey Dee").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-1) The band currently consists of Diamond and LaRocque alongside guitarist [Mike Wead](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_Wead "Mike Wead"), drummer Matt Thompson (both since 2000) and bassist Pontus Egberg (since 2014).

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_King_Diamond_members&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

Denner left King Diamond after the release of the band's second album _[Abigail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abigail\_(album) "Abigail (album)")_ in 1987,[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-2) with [Mike Moon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_Moon_(musician) "Mike Moon (musician)") taking his place for a European tour at the end of the year.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3) Hansen also left after the tour, with Hal Patino joining alongside Moon's replacement Pete Blakk.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-4) By the end of the year, Dee had also left King Diamond.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-5) Dee was briefly replaced by Chris Whitemeier,[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-6) before he was asked to return as a session drummer for the recording of _[Conspiracy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conspiracy\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "Conspiracy (King Diamond album)")_ the following year.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)[Snowy Shaw](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snowy_Shaw "Snowy Shaw") joined as Dee's replacement prior to the beginning of touring for the album, shortly after his 21st birthday.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-7)

Following the release of _[The Eye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Eye\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "The Eye (King Diamond album)")_, the band went into a five-year period of silence. The band would reform in 1994, adding guitarist Herb Simonsen, bassist [Chris Estes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chris_Estes "Chris Estes"), and drummer Darrin Anthony for the album _[The Spider's Lullabye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Spider's\_Lullabye "The Spider's Lullabye")_, released the following year.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-9) Due to injuries suffered in a road traffic accident, Anthony was forced to leave the band shortly after the release of the 1996 follow-up _[The Graveyard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Graveyard\_(album) "The Graveyard (album)")_, with John Luke Hebert taking his place.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-10) Simonsen left after the release of 1998's _[Voodoo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voodoo\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "Voodoo (King Diamond album)")_, with [Glen Drover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glen_Drover "Glen Drover") taking his place.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)[Paul David Harbour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_David_Harbour "Paul David Harbour") took over from Estes for 2000's _[House of God](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House\_of\_God\_(album) "House of God (album)")_,[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-11) after which Drover, Harbour, and Hebert all left the band.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3)

Harbour, Drover, and Hebert were replaced by returning Hal Patino, and new additions Mike Wead and Matt Thompson, respectively in 2000.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-members-3) This lineup of the band remained stable for over 13 years and three studio albums, before Patino was fired in July 2014.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-12) He was replaced by [The Poodles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Poodles "The Poodles") bassist Pontus Egberg.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_King_Diamond_members#cite_note-13)

Musical artist

**Timi Hansen** (28 October 1958 – 4 November 2019) was a Danish bass player. He played in the Danish [heavy metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") band [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate")[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen#cite_note-1) from 1981 to 1985 and from 1992 to 1993, and its successor project [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") from 1985 to 1987.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen#cite_note-2)

He played with his fingers rather than with a [guitar pick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guitar_pick "Guitar pick").

Many[_[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation\_needed "Wikipedia:Citation needed")_] have asked about how Hansen acquired "Grabber" as a nickname. Timi apparently used to play a [Gibson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gibson_(guitar_company) "Gibson (guitar company)")[G3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gibson_G3 "Gibson G3") Grabber. A music store clerk began to call him "Grabber" and the name stuck. Aware that the meaning might be misunderstood, he slowly changed his stage name, Timi Grabber, back to his real name, Timi Hansen.

## Personal life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Timi_Hansen&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Personal life")]

On 1 August 2019, King Diamond announced that Mercyful Fate would play on [Copenhell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhell "Copenhell") and some tour concerts, but Hansen would not attend and was replaced by [Joey Vera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joey_Vera "Joey Vera"). He explained through [Livia Zita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Livia_Zita "Livia Zita")'s account that he was fighting [cancer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cancer "Cancer").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen#cite_note-3)

Hansen died on 4 November 2019, one week after his 61st birthday.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen#cite_note-4)

_**A Matter of Attitude**_ is the second album by Danish rock band [Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fate_(band) "Fate (band)"), released in 1986.

The album was in the hook-filled [melodic hard rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arena_rock "Arena rock")/[pop metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glam_metal "Glam metal") vein, featuring tight [vocal harmonies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harmony "Harmony") over a strong [rhythm section](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhythm_section "Rhythm section"), guitar, and sweeping synthesizer. Stylistically it was like [Europe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europe_(band) "Europe (band)") with a bit more bite. "Won't Stop" was the album's first single, and the track was also released in an extended 12" remix version. The album was almost entirely hard-driving rockers, without the [power ballads](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_ballad "Power ballad") of many other bands of the genre. Original closer was "Do It", a tongue-in-cheek retro [Louis Armstrong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Armstrong "Louis Armstrong")-style shuffle of the type [David Lee Roth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lee_Roth "David Lee Roth") and [David Johansen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Johansen "David Johansen") were experimenting with at the time.

After a decade and a half out of print, the album was re-released on CD by independent label MTM Classix in 2004. The re-release includes lyrics and liner notes, including a new thank-you section. The collection ends with two new bonus tracks. The first, "Hardcore Romance", is in a rawer style, sans the keyboards prevalent throughout the original '80s recording. The second, "Memories of You", makes up for the lack of balladry in the original track list, bringing back a subtler wash of keyboards and a subdued guitar.

**Fate** is a Danish rock band originally formed in 1984. They released four albums between 1984 and 1990 before disbanding in 1993. However, after a one-off reunion at a German music festival in 2004, Fate was reformed and released a new album, _V_, in 2006. In 2010, the band released _Best of Fate 25 Years_ on EMI and, in November 2011, the album _Ghosts from the Past_ was released on AOR Heaven in EU and Rubicon in Japan.

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fate_(band)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

The band Fate formed when former [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate") guitarist Hank Shermann (René Krolmark), Maxim Reality singer Jeff "Lox" Limbo (Jens Meinert), bass / keyboard player Pete Steiner (Peter Steincke) and drummer Bob Lance (Bjarne Holm),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fate_(band)#cite_note-LarkinHR-1) met with producer Simon Hanhart. The band recorded _[Cruisin' for a Bruisin'](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cruisin'\_for\_a\_Bruisin'\_(Fate\_album) "Cruisin' for a Bruisin' (Fate album)")_ in 1988,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fate_(band)#cite_note-LarkinHR-1) which featured the single "Lovers" (released as a single plus videoclip in 1988) and a new version of "Love on the Rox" from the band's debut.

## From today's featured article

[![Image 4: White-headed fruit dove](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8e/PtilopusEugeniaeKeulemans_%28cropped%29.jpg/250px-PtilopusEugeniaeKeulemans_%28cropped%29.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:PtilopusEugeniaeKeulemans_(cropped).jpg "White-headed fruit dove")

The **[white-headed fruit dove](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White-headed_fruit_dove "White-headed fruit dove")** (_Ptilinopus eugeniae_) is a species of bird in the pigeon family, [Columbidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columbidae "Columbidae"). It was [described](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Species_description "Species description") by [John Gould](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Gould "John Gould") in 1856, and the [specific name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Specific_name_(zoology) "Specific name (zoology)")_eugeniae_ honours [Eugénie de Montijo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eug%C3%A9nie_de_Montijo "Eugénie de Montijo"). Adults of the species have white heads, a purplish-red breast patch, a grey shoulder patch, olive-green [upperparts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_bird_terms#upperparts "Glossary of bird terms"), greenish [underparts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_bird_terms#underparts "Glossary of bird terms") with a blue tinge, and a yellowish [vent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_bird_terms#vent "Glossary of bird terms"). Juveniles have green heads with the white restricted to the forehead and upper throat, a much smaller grey shoulder patch, and the red breast patch restricted to the centre of the breast. The species is [endemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Endemism "Endemism") to [Makira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makira "Makira") and the nearby islands of [Ugi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ugi_Island "Ugi Island") and [Malaupaina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaupaina "Malaupaina") in the Solomon Islands. It inhabits lowland, hill, and ridge forest, along with neighbouring agricultural areas, and is especially common in [foothills](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foothills "Foothills"). Its diet consists of small-seeded fruits and berries. The [IUCN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Union_for_Conservation_of_Nature "International Union for Conservation of Nature") considers it a [least-concern species](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Least-concern_species "Least-concern species"). Although it can adapt to [disturbed habitat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disturbance_(ecology) "Disturbance (ecology)"), it is threatened by [deforestation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deforestation "Deforestation") and [habitat loss](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Habitat_destruction "Habitat destruction"). _(**[Full article...](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White-headed\_fruit\_dove "White-headed fruit dove")**)_

Main building of the Marin County Civic Center

*   ... that **[a California county government building](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marin_County_Civic_Center "Marin County Civic Center")**_(pictured)_ inspired elements of Naboo in the _Star Wars_ prequel trilogy?
*   ... that **[Toribia Álvaro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toribia_%C3%81lvaro "Toribia Álvaro")** became a candidate for the Bolivian parliament because no other women of the [Uru of Lake Poopó](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uru-Murato "Uru-Murato") were willing to run?
*   ... that [Mark Twain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Twain "Mark Twain") said that the **[Charlton Public Library](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlton_Public_Library_(Massachusetts) "Charlton Public Library (Massachusetts)")** banning one of his books was "not of the slightest interest to him"?
*   ... that Dutch painter **[Henry van Velthuysen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henry_van_Velthuysen "Henry van Velthuysen")** dismissed a contemporary's works as "infantile construction-kit shapes"?
*   ... that the spirit **[Ti Jean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ti_Jean "Ti Jean")**, a one-legged cannibal highwayman, evokes colonial fear of [maroons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maroons "Maroons")?
*   ... that abolitionist **[Alba Honeywell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alba_Honeywell "Alba Honeywell")** said he sold the first published copy of anti-slavery novel _[Uncle Tom's Cabin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uncle\_Tom's\_Cabin "Uncle Tom's Cabin")_?
*   ... that **[Samoa has 225 species of fern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flora_of_Samoa "Flora of Samoa")**, more than New Zealand, a country 85 times larger?
*   ... that **[Kelvin Kong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelvin_Kong "Kelvin Kong")**, the first recognised Indigenous Australian surgeon, was made a member of the Order of Australia for his services to Indigenous health?
*   ... that **[Pan Pan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pan_Pan_(giant_panda) "Pan Pan (giant panda)")** is thought to have had more than 130 descendants?

"**Blindfold Me**" is a [hip hop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_hop_music "Hip hop music") song by American singer [Kelis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelis "Kelis") from her fourth studio album, _[Kelis Was Here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelis\_Was\_Here "Kelis Was Here")_ (2006). It was written and produced by [Sean Garrett](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sean_Garrett "Sean Garrett") and [Polow da Don](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polow_da_Don "Polow da Don"). A [remix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remix "Remix"), featuring American rapper [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas "Nas"), was released as the album's second single in the United States on October 3, 2006. Although [the Neptunes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Neptunes "The Neptunes") were long-time collaborators of Kelis, _Kelis Was Here_ was her first album without their involvement as she opted for a more diverse team of [record producers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Record_producer "Record producer"), which included Garrett and Polow da Don.

The song's lyrics focus on [sex talk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sex_talk "Sex talk"). Along with hip hop, music critics associated the track's style with [pop rap](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_rap "Pop rap") and [club music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Club_music "Club music"). Upon its release, "Blindfold Me" received a mixed response. While some critics cited it as a highlight from _Kelis Was Here_ and enjoyed Kelis's sexual personality, others criticized its placement on the album's track listing as resulting in a jarring tonal shift.

[Marc Klasfeld](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marc_Klasfeld "Marc Klasfeld") directed the song's music video, which features Nas [tying up](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bondage_(BDSM) "Bondage (BDSM)") Kelis. Premiering September 6, 2006, the video was shown on an episode of the documentary series _[Access Granted](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Access\_Granted "Access Granted")_ alongside a behind-the-scenes feature. The song was further promoted with a [12-inch single](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/12-inch_single "12-inch single"), released on October 3, 2006. "Blindfold Me" peaked at number 91 on _[Billboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard\_(magazine) "Billboard (magazine)")_'s [Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hot_R&B/Hip-Hop_Songs "Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs") chart.

## Production and release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Blindfold_Me&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Production and release")]

[Sean Garrett](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sean_Garrett "Sean Garrett") and [Polow da Don](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polow_da_Don "Polow da Don") wrote and produced "Blindfold Me" for [Kelis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelis "Kelis")'s fourth studio album _[Kelis Was Here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelis\_Was\_Here "Kelis Was Here")_ (2006). Polow da Don is credited under his legal name Jamal Jones in the [liner notes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liner_notes "Liner notes").[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTE''Kelis_Was_Here''2006-3) In 2006 articles for [_Billboard_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_(magazine) "Billboard (magazine)") and [_Vibe_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vibe_(magazine) "Vibe (magazine)"), music critics cited Polow da Don's work on "Blindfold Me" as part of his rising popularity as a [record producer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Record_producer "Record producer").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEGale200668-4)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHope2006b33-5) Kelis recruited new producers for _Kelis Was Here_, including Garrett and Polow da Don, after separating from long-time collaborators [the Neptunes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Neptunes "The Neptunes").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFinney2006-6) She had worked with the duo since her debut studio album [_Kaleidoscope_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaleidoscope_(Kelis_album) "Kaleidoscope (Kelis album)") in 1999,[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTESalmon2006-7) and was their "diva of choice" to sing [hooks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hook_(music) "Hook (music)") on other artists' songs.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEShapiro2003554-8) In a 2020 interview, Kelis said her collaboration with other producers for her third studio album caused a rift in their professional relationship.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFu2020-9)

[![Image 8: Nas holding a cigar, a glass, and a microphone. He is looking away from the camera.](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/14/NasirJones.png/250px-NasirJones.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:NasirJones.png)

[Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas "Nas") (_pictured in 2007_) was featured on the "Blindfold Me" remix, and appears in its music video.

A [remix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remix "Remix") for "Blindfold Me" includes a [verse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Verse_(music) "Verse (music)") written and performed by Kelis's husband [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas "Nas").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHope2006a73-10)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blindfold_Me#cite_note-FOOTNOTEO'Donnell2006-11) They had collaborated on four other songs: "[Hey Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God's_Son_(album) "God's Son (album)")" (2002), "[Popular Thug](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clones_(album) "Clones (album)")" (2003), "

## [Viejo Oeste](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viejo_Oeste "Viejo Oeste")

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1d/Sitting_bull_and_buffalo_bill_c1885.jpg/250px-Sitting_bull_and_buffalo_bill_c1885.jpg?utm_source=es.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:Sitting_bull_and_buffalo_bill_c1885.jpg)

El [siux](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siux "Siux")[Toro Sentado](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toro_Sentado "Toro Sentado") (1831-1890) y el cazador de bisontes [Buffalo Bill](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buffalo_Bill "Buffalo Bill") (1845-1917).

**Viejo Oeste**, **antiguo Oeste**, **salvaje Oeste**, **lejano Oeste** o **la Frontera** (en inglés _Old West_, _Wild West_, _Far West_ o _The Frontier)_ son los términos con que se denomina a los hechos históricos (con sus protagonistas) que tuvieron lugar entre el siglo XIX y principios del siglo XX durante la expansión de la frontera de los [Estados Unidos](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Estados_Unidos "Estados Unidos") hacia la costa del [océano Pacífico](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oc%C3%A9ano_Pac%C3%ADfico "Océano Pacífico"). Aunque la colonización del territorio comenzó en el siglo XVI con la llegada de los primeros [europeos](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Europa "Europa"), sobre todo [españoles](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pueblo_espa%C3%B1ol "Pueblo español"), el objetivo de alcanzar la costa oeste se debió a la iniciativa gubernamental del presidente [Thomas Jefferson](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Jefferson "Thomas Jefferson"), tras la [compra de Luisiana](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compra_de_Luisiana "Compra de Luisiana") en 1803. La expansión de la frontera fue considerada como una búsqueda de oportunidades y progreso para la burguesía blanca y los desposeídos.

Esta incesante y prolongada migración de personas hacia el oeste desplazó culturas ancestrales y oprimió a pueblos originarios del subcontinente norteamericano. En contraste, el período suscitó importantes avances en la [industria](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Industria "Industria"), las [comunicaciones](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transporte "Transporte") y la [agricultura](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agricultura "Agricultura"), a costa en muchos casos de una intensa explotación de los recursos humanos y naturales.

Estos eventos históricos, origen de un [mito](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mito "Mito") nacional en los Estados Unidos («Mito de la Frontera»), inspirado en la llamada [Doctrina del destino manifiesto](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctrina_del_destino_manifiesto "Doctrina del destino manifiesto"), han sido recreados por diversas manifestaciones del arte, agrupadas bajo el género _[wéstern](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/W%C3%A9stern "Wéstern")_. Este género narra historias de _[cowboys](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaquero "Vaquero")_, [pioneros](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pionero_de_Norteam%C3%A9rica "Pionero de Norteamérica"), [amerindios](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amerindio "Amerindio"), [gambusinos](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambusino "Gambusino"), empresarios, etc.; historias de gentes de variada condición que emprendieron la aventura del oeste con la esperanza de alcanzar el éxito personal, pero que acabaron, no pocas veces, enfrentadas a la justicia o al fatal [destino](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Destino "Destino"). Los estudios actuales consideran que detrás de esta mitificación se esconde una realidad más compleja, por lo que se tiende a replantear el papel de todos los actores que participaron en aquella coyuntura social, económica y cultural que fue la frontera estadounidense en el siglo XIX y principios del siglo XX.
