## [GRB 980425](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/GRB_980425 "GRB 980425")

[![Image 8: GRB 980425](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/21/Blow-up_of_area_around_GRB_980425_%28heic0003c%29.jpg/250px-Blow-up_of_area_around_GRB_980425_%28heic0003c%29.jpg?utm_source=es.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:Blow-up_of_area_around_GRB_980425_(heic0003c).jpg "GRB 980425")

GRB 980425

**GRB 980425** fue un [brote de rayos gamma](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brote_de_rayos_gamma "Brote de rayos gamma"), una explosión extremadamente energética que libera una gran cantidad de [radiación gamma](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rayos_gamma "Rayos gamma") durante un breve intervalo de tiempo. El satélite [BeppoSAX](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/BeppoSax "BeppoSax") lo detectó el 25 de abril de 1998 a las 21:49 UTC. Este evento se considera uno de los hitos astronómicos más relevantes de finales del siglo XX, debido a que proporcionó una de las primeras evidencias observacionales de la relación entre los estallidos de rayos gamma de larga duración y las [supernovas](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supernova "Supernova") originadas por el colapso del [núcleo estelar](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%BAcleo_estelar "Núcleo estelar").

Se encuentra a una distancia de aproximadamente 40 [megaparsecs](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%A1rsec "Pársec"), por lo que continúa registrado como el estallido de rayos gamma más cercano a la [Tierra](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tierra "Tierra") descubierto hasta la fecha.

[![Image 10: La Gran Muralla China](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a4/GreatWall6.jpg/500px-GreatWall6.jpg?utm_source=es.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Archivo:GreatWall6.jpg "La Gran Muralla China")

La Gran Muralla China

La Gran Muralla China

La **[Gran Muralla china](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gran_Muralla_china "Gran Muralla china")** es una antigua fortificación [china](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reinos_Combatientes "Reinos Combatientes") construida para proteger el imperio de China desde el siglo III a.C. de los ataques de los [nómadas](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%B3mada "Nómada")[xiongnu](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiongnu "Xiongnu") de [Mongolia](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mongolia "Mongolia") y [Manchuria](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchuria "Manchuria"). El principal propósito del muro no era impedir que fuera atravesado, sino más bien impedir que los invasores trajeran [caballerías](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caballer%C3%ADa "Caballería") con ellos.

# School facts for kids

[Kids Encyclopedia Facts](https://kids.kiddle.co/)

For other uses, see School (disambiguation).

"Schooling" redirects here. For the surname, see Schooling (surname).

[![Image 3: First primary school building in Nigeria in Badagry, Nigeria](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/7/7b/First_primary_school_building_in_Nigeria_in_Badagry%2C_Nigeria.jpg/300px-First_primary_school_building_in_Nigeria_in_Badagry%2C_Nigeria.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:First_primary_school_building_in_Nigeria_in_Badagry,_Nigeria.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:First_primary_school_building_in_Nigeria_in_Badagry,_Nigeria.jpg "Enlarge")

 First [primary school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school") in [Nigeria](https://kids.kiddle.co/Nigeria "Nigeria"), built in 1845

[![Image 4: 1st High school of Argos, Greece](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/e/ec/1st_High_school_of_Argos%2C_Greece.jpg/300px-1st_High_school_of_Argos%2C_Greece.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:1st_High_school_of_Argos,_Greece.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:1st_High_school_of_Argos,_Greece.jpg "Enlarge")

 A [high school](https://kids.kiddle.co/High_school "High school") building in [Argos, Greece](https://kids.kiddle.co/Argos,_Peloponnese "Argos, Peloponnese")

A **school** is a place where students go to learn. It's an educational institution designed to help students learn from [teachers](https://kids.kiddle.co/Teacher "Teacher"). Most countries have a system of formal [education](https://kids.kiddle.co/Education "Education"), and sometimes it's even required by law for children to attend. In these systems, students move through different levels of schools. These schools can be run by the government or by private groups.

The names for schools can be different in various countries. But generally, there's [primary school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school") for younger children and [secondary school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Secondary_school "Secondary school") for teenagers. After secondary school, many students go to a university college or [university](https://kids.kiddle.co/University "University") for [higher education](https://kids.kiddle.co/Higher_education "Higher education").

Before primary school, very young children (usually ages 3–5) might go to [Kindergarten](https://kids.kiddle.co/Kindergarten "Kindergarten") or [preschool](https://kids.kiddle.co/Preschool "Preschool"). After secondary school, options include [vocational school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Vocational_school "Vocational school") (for job skills), [college](https://kids.kiddle.co/College "College"), or [seminary](https://kids.kiddle.co/Seminary "Seminary") (for religious studies). Some schools focus on one specific area, like a school for dance or economics. There are also Alternative schools that offer different ways of learning.

Schools not run by the government are called [private schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Private_school "Private school"). They might be needed if government schools don't offer specific types of education. Some private schools are religious, like Christian schools, [madrasas](https://kids.kiddle.co/Madrasa "Madrasa") (Islamic schools), or [yeshivas](https://kids.kiddle.co/Yeshiva "Yeshiva") (Jewish schools). Other private schools might offer a higher standard of education or focus on special achievements. For adults, there are schools for corporate training, military education and training, and [business schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Business_school "Business school").

Some people have concerns about the school system. They might say it doesn't always prepare students well for their future lives. They also suggest that schools sometimes limit [creativity](https://kids.kiddle.co/Creativity "Creativity") by telling students exactly what to do and how. Using things like [grades](https://kids.kiddle.co/Grading_in_education "Grading in education") and [homework](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homework "Homework") might also reduce a child's natural [curiosity](https://kids.kiddle.co/Curiosity "Curiosity") and desire to learn.

In [homeschooling](https://kids.kiddle.co/Homeschooling "Homeschooling") and [distance education](https://kids.kiddle.co/Distance_education "Distance education"), learning happens outside a traditional school building. This can be at home or through a virtual school online. Schools are organized in different ways, like having separate departments or smaller learning groups.

## What Does "School" Mean?

The word _school_ comes from the [Greek](https://kids.kiddle.co/Greek_language "Greek language") word _scholē_. This word originally meant "leisure" or "free time." Later, it came to mean "a group of people who are given lectures" or "a place of learning."

## How Schools Started and Grew

[![Image 5: Plato's Academy mosaic from Pompeii](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/4/48/Plato%27s_Academy_mosaic_from_Pompeii.jpg/300px-Plato%27s_Academy_mosaic_from_Pompeii.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Plato%27s_Academy_mosaic_from_Pompeii.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Plato%27s_Academy_mosaic_from_Pompeii.jpg "Enlarge")

[Plato](https://kids.kiddle.co/Plato "Plato")'s academy, mosaic from Pompeii

The idea of bringing students together in one place to learn has been around for a very long time. Formal schools existed in [ancient Greece](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ancient_Greece "Ancient Greece") (like [Plato's Academy](https://kids.kiddle.co/Academy "Academy")), [ancient Rome](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ancient_Rome "Ancient Rome"), [ancient India](https://kids.kiddle.co/History_of_India "History of India") (called Gurukuls), and [ancient China](https://kids.kiddle.co/History_of_China "History of China"). The [Byzantine Empire](https://kids.kiddle.co/Byzantine_Empire "Byzantine Empire") had a strong school system starting in 425 AD. This system helped make sure many citizens, including soldiers, had at least a basic education.

In Western Europe, many cathedral schools were started in the [Early Middle Ages](https://kids.kiddle.co/Early_Middle_Ages "Early Middle Ages"). These schools trained future religious leaders and administrators. Some of the oldest schools still running today include The King's School, Canterbury (started 597 CE). Starting in the 5th century CE, monastic schools also appeared, teaching both religious and everyday subjects.

[![Image 6: BogdanovBelsky UstnySchet](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/a/a7/BogdanovBelsky_UstnySchet.jpg/300px-BogdanovBelsky_UstnySchet.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:BogdanovBelsky_UstnySchet.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:BogdanovBelsky_UstnySchet.jpg "Enlarge")

 Mental calculations. In the school of S. Rachinsky by Nikolay Bogdanov-Belsky. Russia, 1895.

In Europe, universities began in the 12th century. For a long time, the main goal of schools (not universities) was to teach [Latin](https://kids.kiddle.co/Latin "Latin"). This is why some schools were called [grammar schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Grammar_school "Grammar school"). Over time, school lessons grew to include reading and writing in local languages, as well as technical, artistic, scientific, and practical subjects.

Going to school became required in parts of Europe during the 18th century. For example, in [Denmark-Norway](https://kids.kiddle.co/Denmark-Norway "Denmark-Norway"), this started in 1739–1741 to help more people learn to read and write. Many early public schools in the United States were [one-room schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/One-room_school "One-room school"). A single teacher taught all ages of boys and girls in the same room. By the 1920s, these one-room schools started to combine into larger buildings with many classrooms. [School buses](https://kids.kiddle.co/Bus "Bus") then helped students get to these bigger schools.

[Islam](https://kids.kiddle.co/Islam "Islam") also developed its own school system. Learning was very important, so a structured way of teaching was needed. At first, [mosques](https://kids.kiddle.co/Mosque "Mosque") were used for both religious activities and learning. But by the 9th century, the [madrassa](https://kids.kiddle.co/Madrasa "Madrasa") was introduced. This was a school built separately from the mosque, like [al-Qarawiyyin](https://kids.kiddle.co/University_of_al-Qarawiyyin "University of al-Qarawiyyin"), founded in 859 CE. These were some of the first public school systems.

Under the [Ottomans](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ottoman_Empire "Ottoman Empire"), cities like [Bursa](https://kids.kiddle.co/Bursa "Bursa") and [Edirne](https://kids.kiddle.co/Edirne "Edirne") became major learning centers. The Ottoman system of Külliye was a complex of buildings that included a mosque, hospital, madrassa, and public kitchens. This made education more available to everyone by offering free meals, healthcare, and sometimes even free places to stay.

## Different Names for Schools Around the World

The word "school" and the names for different education levels can change from country to country.

### Schools in the United Kingdom and Commonwealth Countries

In the United Kingdom, "school" usually means places for learning before university. These include [pre-schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Preschool "Preschool") or [nursery schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Preschool "Preschool"), [primary schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school"), and [secondary schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Secondary_school "Secondary school"). Most schools in the UK are funded by the public and are free to attend. These are called [state schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/State_school "State school"). There are also private schools that charge fees. Some very old and famous private schools are called [public schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Public_school_(United_Kingdom) "Public school (United Kingdom)"), which can be confusing because in North America, a "public school" is usually free and government-funded.

Many countries in the [Commonwealth of Nations](https://kids.kiddle.co/Commonwealth_of_Nations "Commonwealth of Nations"), like Australia, New Zealand, India, and South Africa, use "school" in a similar way for pre-university education.

### Schools in India

[![Image 7: Loyola School](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/f/f4/Loyola_School.jpg/300px-Loyola_School.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Loyola_School.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Loyola_School.jpg "Enlarge")

 Loyola School, Chennai, India – run by the Catholic Diocese of Madras. Christian missionaries helped start modern schools in India.

In ancient India, schools were called Gurukuls. These were traditional Hindu learning centers, often at a teacher's home. Today, schools in India are often called _Vidyashram_, _Vidyalayam_, _Vidya Mandir_, or _Vidya Bhavan_. In southern languages, they might be called _Pallikoodam_. During the Mughal rule, [Madrasahs](https://kids.kiddle.co/Madrasa "Madrasa") were introduced for Muslim children.

Records from the 18th century show that education was common in India, with a school in most villages. Subjects included reading, writing, math, and even science.

[![Image 8: Perumacheri AUP School](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/0/05/Perumacheri_AUP_School.JPG/300px-Perumacheri_AUP_School.JPG)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Perumacheri_AUP_School.JPG)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Perumacheri_AUP_School.JPG "Enlarge")

 A school building in [Kannur](https://kids.kiddle.co/Kannur "Kannur"), India

When the British ruled India, Christian missionaries started many schools. These schools became popular and set the standard for modern schooling in India. Today, most schools follow a similar model for teaching and subjects.

Schools in India vary greatly, from large campuses with many students and high fees to small schools where children learn under a tree for free. There are different education boards, like the Central Board for Secondary Education (CBSE). Typical subjects include languages, math, science (physics, chemistry, biology), geography, history, and computer science. Students also do activities like sports, music, and drama.

### Schools in Europe

[![Image 9: 1887 Bettannier Der Schwarze Fleck anagoria](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/5/57/1887_Bettannier_Der_Schwarze_Fleck_anagoria.jpg/300px-1887_Bettannier_Der_Schwarze_Fleck_anagoria.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:1887_Bettannier_Der_Schwarze_Fleck_anagoria.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:1887_Bettannier_Der_Schwarze_Fleck_anagoria.jpg "Enlarge")

 Albert Bettannier's 1887 painting _La Tache noire_ shows a child learning about the "lost" province of [Alsace-Lorraine](https://kids.kiddle.co/Alsace-Lorraine "Alsace-Lorraine"). This shows how European schools sometimes taught [Nationalism](https://kids.kiddle.co/Nationalism "Nationalism").

In many parts of Europe, "school" usually refers to [primary education](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school") (lasting 4 to 9 years) and [secondary education](https://kids.kiddle.co/Secondary_school "Secondary school"). Secondary schools are often split into _[Gymnasiums](https://kids.kiddle.co/Gymnasium\_(school) "Gymnasium (school)")_ (for academic studies) and [vocational schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Vocational_school "Vocational school") (for job training). The term "school" is rarely used for higher education, except for some "upper" or "high" schools (like _Hochschule_ in Germany), which are colleges and universities.

In [Eastern Europe](https://kids.kiddle.co/Eastern_Europe "Eastern Europe"), primary and secondary education are often combined. Schools are classified by "degrees" of education: primary, unfinished secondary, and finished secondary. The first two degrees (eight years) are usually included, and the last one (two years) allows students to go on to vocational or specialized training.

### Schools in North America and the United States

[![Image 10: Farm Security Administration school in Alabama USA 1935](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/3/30/Farm_Security_Administration_school_in_Alabama_USA_1935.gif/300px-Farm_Security_Administration_school_in_Alabama_USA_1935.gif)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Farm_Security_Administration_school_in_Alabama_USA_1935.gif)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Farm_Security_Administration_school_in_Alabama_USA_1935.gif "Enlarge")

 One-room school in 1935, [Alabama](https://kids.kiddle.co/Alabama "Alabama")

In North America, "school" can mean almost any place of learning. This includes [preschool](https://kids.kiddle.co/Preschool "Preschool") (for very young children), [kindergarten](https://kids.kiddle.co/Kindergarten "Kindergarten"), [elementary school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school"), [middle school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Middle_school "Middle school") (or junior high), [high school](https://kids.kiddle.co/High_school "High school"), college, university, and [graduate school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Graduate_school "Graduate school").

In the United States, each state's department of education checks how well schools are doing. Charter schools are public schools that have more freedom from some rules. The terms [grammar school](https://kids.kiddle.co/Grammar_school "Grammar school") and _grade school_ are sometimes used for primary schools. There are also magnet schools, which are tax-funded and offer special programs not found in regular schools.

### Schools in Africa

In West Africa, "school" can also mean "bush" schools, Quranic schools, or apprenticeships. These include both formal and informal learning.

Bush schools are training camps where cultural skills, traditions, and knowledge are passed down. They are separate from the main community, located in forests. Students stay there until their training is done, and visitors are not allowed. Boys and girls attend separate bush schools. Boys learn crafts, fighting, hunting, and community laws. Girls learn domestic skills like cooking, childcare, and how to be a good wife.

[![Image 11: Serrekundamadrassa](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/5/55/Serrekundamadrassa.JPG/300px-Serrekundamadrassa.JPG)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Serrekundamadrassa.JPG)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Serrekundamadrassa.JPG "Enlarge")

 A _[madrasah](https://kids.kiddle.co/Madrasa "Madrasa")_ in the Gambia

Qur'anic schools are the main way to learn about the Quran and the Islamic faith. They also helped with reading and writing during colonial times. Today, they focus on reading, memorizing, and reciting the Quran. Children often go to both state schools and a Qur'anic school.

In Nigeria, "school" includes [daycares](https://kids.kiddle.co/Child_care "Child care"), [nursery schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Preschool "Preschool"), [primary schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Primary_school "Primary school"), [secondary schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Secondary_school "Secondary school"), and universities. Primary and secondary schools can be privately funded (by religious groups or companies) or government-funded (called public schools). Students spend six years in primary school, three years in junior secondary, and three years in senior secondary. The first nine years of schooling are required. Universities can be funded by the government, religious groups, or private organizations.

## Who Owns and Runs Schools?

Many schools are owned or funded by the government. [Private schools](https://kids.kiddle.co/Private_school "Private school") operate independently. Private schools usually get their money from fees paid by families whose children attend. However, some private schools might also get government help, like through School vouchers. Many private schools are connected to a specific religion and are called parochial schools.

## What You Find in Most Schools

[![Image 12: Rathaykentst](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/6/61/Rathaykentst.jpg/300px-Rathaykentst.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Rathaykentst.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Rathaykentst.jpg "Enlarge")

 A school entrance building in Australia

Schools are designed for teaching and learning. The most important parts are the classrooms where teachers teach and students learn. Classrooms might be special for certain subjects, like labs for science or workshops for art.

Typical schools also have many other rooms and areas:

*   [Cafeteria](https://kids.kiddle.co/Caf%C3%A9 "Café") (or dining hall) where students eat lunch, breakfast, and snacks.

| Formerly of | * [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") * IllWill |

Musical artist

**Andy LaRocque** (born **Anders Allhage**, 29 November 1962) is a Swedish guitarist, songwriter and record producer, best known for being a member of the [heavy metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") band [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") from 1985 until his departure in 2026.

## Biography

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Andy_LaRocque&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Biography")]

LaRocque started out in the mid 1980s in the [Gothenburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gothenburg "Gothenburg")[hard rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_rock "Hard rock") bands Trafalgar and an early version of [Swedish Erotica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Erotica "Swedish Erotica").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-Shreds-1)

He played on the [Death](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Death_(metal_band) "Death (metal band)") album _[Individual Thought Patterns](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Individual\_Thought\_Patterns "Individual Thought Patterns")_ in 1993.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-2)

LaRocque contributed a guitar solo to the track "Cold" on the 1995 album _[Slaughter of the Soul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slaughter\_of\_the\_Soul "Slaughter of the Soul")_ by Swedish melodic death metal group [At the Gates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/At_the_Gates "At the Gates"). Producer [Fredrik Nordström](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fredrik_Nordstr%C3%B6m "Fredrik Nordström") was responsible for the idea, and telephoned LaRocque.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-AtTheGatesLucemFero-3) At the Gates' guitarist [Anders Björler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anders_Bj%C3%B6rler "Anders Björler") gave LaRocque an audio cassette recording of the song. The tape played at the wrong speed at LaRocque's house, so LaRocque had to transcribe the recording.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-AtTheGatesLucemFero-3) Two days after receiving the cassette, LaRocque laid down a guitar solo for the song within half an hour. Björler described the solo as "great" and in a November 2007 interview admitted he still couldn't play the solo "properly".[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-AtTheGatesLucemFero-3)

He played on the 1995 IllWill album _Evilution_, along with former members of [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-Shreds-1)

LaRocque opened a studio called the "Los Angered Recordings" in [Angered](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angered "Angered"), [Sweden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweden "Sweden") in 1995, where he produced and recorded albums for many bands. In 2007, he moved the studio to [Varberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Varberg "Varberg") and renamed it "Sonic Train Studios" where he continues to record and produce for various rock and heavy metal bands.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-4)

He can be heard on the 2002 [Falconer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falconer_(band) "Falconer (band)") album _[Chapters from a Vale Forlorn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chapters\_from\_a\_Vale\_Forlorn "Chapters from a Vale Forlorn")_, where he performed lead guitars on the song "Busted to the Floor".[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-SteelMill-5)

He is known for his signature playing style which incorporates [neoclassical](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neoclassical_metal "Neoclassical metal") elements, using exotic scales such as harmonic minor, phrygian dominant, and diminished minor. His extended theory knowledge enables him to mix these scales with others such as the blues scale and melodic minor. He has a distinct guitar tone for his solos, and often incorporates layers of harmonies over his runs and phrasing. He frequently uses a mixture of classically-flavored arpeggio sequences and alternate picked runs mixed with melodic lines to create his signature style.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-Shreds-1)

LaRocque was nominated for a [Grammy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award "Grammy Award") in 2007.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-6) He is regularly listed as among the best or most underrated guitarists in heavy metal.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-8) He cites [Michael Schenker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Schenker "Michael Schenker") and [Randy Rhoads](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Randy_Rhoads "Randy Rhoads") as major influences. He also likes [Steve Vai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Vai "Steve Vai") and [Tony Iommi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tony_Iommi "Tony Iommi"), and was impressed by the friendliness of [Chuck Schuldiner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chuck_Schuldiner "Chuck Schuldiner") when he recorded _Individual Thought Patterns_ with him.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andy_LaRocque#cite_note-9)

**Alice Cooper** (nacido **Vincent Damon Furnier**; [Detroit](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Detroit "Detroit"), [Míchigan](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%ADchigan "Míchigan"); 4 de febrero de 1948) es un cantante de _[hard rock](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Hard\_rock "Hard rock")_ y _[heavy metal](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Heavy\_metal "Heavy metal")_ estadounidense. **Alice Cooper** fue inicialmente el nombre de una banda de _[rock and roll](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Rock\_and\_roll "Rock and roll")_ en la que Furnier era el vocalista, pionero del [género](https://ninos.kiddle.co/G%C3%A9nero_musical "Género musical") conocido como _shock rock_. Surgido en 1964 en [Arizona](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Arizona "Arizona"), [Estados Unidos](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Estados_Unidos "Estados Unidos"), logró su mayor auge durante los años setenta y alcanzó el éxito comercial con el álbum _Billion Dollar Babies_ de 1973. Posteriormente, Furnier adoptó el nombre de su anterior banda e inició una carrera como solista, convirtiéndose en un importante icono del rock que influiría en diferentes géneros, como el _[heavy metal](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Heavy\_metal "Heavy metal")_, el _[hard rock](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Hard\_rock "Hard rock")_, el _[punk](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Punk "Punk")_ y el _[rock gótico](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Rock\_g%C3%B3tico "Rock gótico")_.

Ha sido referente para artistas y bandas como Rob Zombie y [Marilyn Manson](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Marilyn_Manson "Marilyn Manson"), al ser uno de los pioneros en asociar rock y espectáculo en sus conciertos y en montar pequeñas historias teatrales encima de un escenario donde a la vez tocaba un grupo de [rock](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Rock "Rock") y crear de sí mismo un personaje de pesadilla.

Cooper es reconocido por el uso de maquillajes de aspecto siniestro, inquietantes letras y provocativas representaciones que abarcaban ejecuciones con guillotina y sillas eléctricas o actos con enormes serpientes, que ilustraban los contenidos de sus álbumes, muchos de los cuales narraban una historia, en la más pura línea del álbum conceptual. Alice Cooper sería el primero en desarrollar con más sofisticación las puestas en escena respecto a otros músicos influenciados por la estética "glam-teatral", como [David Bowie](https://ninos.kiddle.co/David_Bowie "David Bowie") o [Peter Gabriel](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Peter_Gabriel "Peter Gabriel"), inspirado notablemente por el cantante Arthur Brown. Esta característica escénica influiría notablemente a grupos como [Kiss](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Kiss "Kiss"), White Zombie, [Mötley Crüe](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%B6tley_Cr%C3%BCe "Mötley Crüe"), Twisted Sister, Vinnie Vincent Invasion, Mercyful Fate y [King Diamond](https://ninos.kiddle.co/King_Diamond "King Diamond"). Dentro de su actitud irreverente destaca el show de cortar bebés con un hacha, filetear una dama frente a un refrigerador abierto e incluso presentarse para presidente contra [Richard Nixon](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Richard_Nixon "Richard Nixon") en Estados Unidos.

Cooper también es famoso por su carismática personalidad fuera del escenario, siendo nombrado el "artista de heavy metal más querido" en el libro _The Rolling Stone Album Guide_, publicado por la famosa revista _[Rolling Stone](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Rolling\_Stone "Rolling Stone")_. Es acreditado como uno de los creadores del sonido y del estilo _heavy metal_, y ha sido descrito como "el primer artista en incluir imaginería de terror en el _rock and roll_, con sus escenarios y montajes terroríficos en concierto". Aparte de la música, Cooper ha actuado en algunas películas, entre las que destacan _Wayne's World_, de [Penelope Spheeris](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Penelope_Spheeris "Penelope Spheeris"), _Sombras Tenebrosas_, de [Tim Burton](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Tim_Burton "Tim Burton") y _The Prince of Darkness_, de [John Carpenter](https://ninos.kiddle.co/John_Carpenter "John Carpenter").

## Biografía

### Primeros años

Furnier nació en [Detroit](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Detroit "Detroit"), [Míchigan](https://ninos.kiddle.co/M%C3%ADchigan "Míchigan"), hijo de Ella Mae y Ether Moroni Furnier. Su padre fue un predicador en la Iglesia de Jesucristo en [Monongahela](https://ninos.kiddle.co/R%C3%ADo_Monongahela "Río Monongahela"), [Pensilvania](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Pensilvania "Pensilvania"). Su nombre era una mezcla del nombre de su tío, Vincent Collier Furnier y del escritor [Damon Runyon](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Damon_Runyon "Damon Runyon"). Su padrino de nacimiento, Thurman Sylvester Furnier, fue apóstol en la mencionada iglesia.

Furnier asistía activamente a la iglesia en su niñez. Debido a complicaciones con su salud en la adolescencia, tuvo que mudarse con su familia a [Phoenix](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Phoenix "Phoenix"), [Arizona](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Arizona "Arizona"), donde logró graduarse en [bellas artes](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Bellas_artes "Bellas artes").

### Años 1960

#### The Spiders

En 1964, un Furnier con apenas 16 años de edad forma la agrupación The Earwigs. Debido a que ninguno de sus miembros sabía tocar aún ningún instrumento musical, inicialmente la banda se vestía como [los Beatles](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Beatles "The Beatles") y hacía mímica con las canciones de la banda británica. Después de unos meses decidieron convertirse en una banda real, aprendieron a tocar instrumentos y cambiaron su nombre a The Spiders, grupo que consistía en Furnier como vocalista, [Glen Buxton](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Glen_Buxton "Glen Buxton") y John Tatum como guitarristas, Dennis Dunaway en el bajo y John Speer en la batería. Musicalmente, el grupo se inspiró en bandas como los mencionados Beatles, [the Rolling Stones](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Rolling_Stones "The Rolling Stones"), [the Who](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Who "The Who"), [the Kinks](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Kinks "The Kinks"), [the Doors](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Doors "The Doors") y [the Yardbirds](https://ninos.kiddle.co/The_Yardbirds "The Yardbirds"). En aproximadamente un año la banda empezó a realizar presentaciones en el área de Phoenix con una telaraña gigante en el fondo del escenario, su primer montaje.

En 1965, the Spiders grabaron su primer sencillo, "Why Don't You Love Me", con Furnier tocando la armónica. El Lado B del sencillo era una versión de [Marvin Gaye](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Marvin_Gaye "Marvin Gaye") titulada "Hitch Hike". El sencillo fue publicado por la disquera local Mascot Records, propiedad de Jack Curtis, promotor y propietario del local juvenil Stage 7, el que se convertiría en el lugar de presentación habitual de the Spiders.

En 1966, Michael Bruce reemplazó a John Tatum en la guitarra rítmica. La banda publicó su segundo sencillo, "Don't Blow Your Mind", una composición original que llegó al primer puesto en las listas de éxitos locales. En 1967, la banda empezó a realizar viajes por tierra a [Los Ángeles](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Los_%C3%81ngeles "Los Ángeles") para brindar conciertos. Pronto cambiaron su nombre a Nazz y publicaron el sencillo "Wonder Who's Lovin' Her Now". El baterista John Speer fue reemplazado por Neal Smith. A finales de ese año, la agrupación se trasladó definitivamente a Los Ángeles.

#### La banda adopta un nuevo nombre: "Alice Cooper"

En 1968 la banda se enteró de que [Todd Rundgren](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Todd_Rundgren "Todd Rundgren") también había estado en una agrupación llamada Nazz, por lo que se vieron en la necesidad de cambiar su nombre. Furnier creía que la banda necesitaba algún truco para llegar al éxito y que otras agrupaciones no estaban explotando lo teatral en sus presentaciones en vivo. Existe una leyenda urbana que dice que el nombre "Alice Cooper" fue escogido en una sesión con la tabla ouija, cuando el espíritu de una niña que vivió en Inglaterra en el siglo XVII llamada Alice Cooper se manifestó ante los miembros de la agrupación. Sin embargo, en una entrevista con Mark Radcliffe en el programa Radcliffe and Maconie de la [BBC Radio 2](https://ninos.kiddle.co/BBC_Radio_2 "BBC Radio 2") el 30 de noviembre de 2009 Alice describió el incidente con la ouija como una "leyenda urbana". Finalmente, Furnier adoptaría este nombre como su nombre artístico.

Cooper y la banda crearon un villano, vestido con prendas femeninas y usando un horrendo maquillaje, pensando que esto les generaría gran publicidad debido a la controversia ocasionada. El personaje del villano era interpretado por el propio Cooper en las presentaciones en vivo de la banda. En 2007, en el libro autobiográfico _Alice Cooper, Golf Monster_ Cooper argumentó que se inspiró en la película de 1962 _What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?_ para el diseño de su maquillaje. La película le dio a Cooper la idea para el maquillaje de sus ojos luego de ver algunas escenas de [Bette Davis](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Bette_Davis "Bette Davis"). También se basaron en el personaje de [Anita Pallenberg](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Anita_Pallenberg "Anita Pallenberg") en la película _Barbarella_.

La formación clásica de Alice Cooper en ese momento consistía en Furnier, el guitarrista líder Glen Buxton, el guitarrista rítmico Michael Bruce, el bajista Dennis Dunaway y el baterista Neal Smith. Cooper, Buxton y Dunaway eran estudiantes de bellas artes, y su admiración por los trabajos surrealistas de [Salvador Dalí](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Salvador_Dal%C3%AD "Salvador Dalí") servirían de inspiración para sus extraños escenarios. Una noche, luego de una presentación en [Venice](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Venice_(Los_%C3%81ngeles) "Venice (Los Ángeles)"), [California](https://ninos.kiddle.co/California "California") en la que el público abandonó el escenario luego de diez minutos de presentación, el mánager [Shep Gordon](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Shep_Gordon "Shep Gordon") arregló una audición para la banda con el músico y reciente productor discográfico [Frank Zappa](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Frank_Zappa "Frank Zappa"), quien se encontraba en la búsqueda de actos poco convencionales para producirlos en su nueva disquera, Straight Records. Zappa convocó a la banda para que se presentara en su casa a las "7 en punto". Los músicos equivocadamente hicieron presencia en la casa de Zappa a las 7 de la mañana. El ser despertado a las 7 de la mañana por una banda que quería tocar una especie de rock psicodélico impresionó lo suficiente a Frank Zappa como para firmar con la banda un contrato de tres álbumes con Straight Records.

El primer álbum de la banda, _Pretties For You_ (publicado en 1969), se ubicó en la posición No. 193 de las listas de éxitos estadounidenses, sin embargo comercialmente fue un fracaso.

La banda continuó generando controversia con sus actuaciones en vivo, lo que indirectamente llevaría a varios medios impresos a crear el término _shock rock_. En un concierto en [Toronto](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Toronto "Toronto") en septiembre de 1969, Cooper arrojó una gallina al público, creyendo que el animal podría volar lejos. Sin embargo, la gallina cayó en la primera fila de la audiencia, ocupada por asistentes en sillas de ruedas. Al día siguiente el incidente apareció en la primera plana de los periódicos.

La agrupación comentaría años más tarde que su principal influencia en esa época era [Pink Floyd](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Pink_Floyd "Pink Floyd"), especialmente el primer álbum de la banda británica, _The Piper at the Gates of Dawn_. Glen Buxton declaró que podía escuchar por horas los riffs de guitarra de [Syd Barrett](https://ninos.kiddle.co/Syd_Barrett "Syd Barrett").

**Kim Bendix Petersen** (born on June 14, 1956), known as **King Diamond**, is a Danish rock musician. He is famous for his powerful singing voice, especially his high-pitched screams. He is the main singer and songwriter for two bands: Mercyful Fate and his own band, King Diamond.

While he plays keyboards and guitar on his albums, he focuses only on singing during live shows. King Diamond is well-known for his dark song lyrics and the stories he tells through his music. He also has a unique stage look, often wearing black and white face paint. Many other rock and metal artists, like [Metallica](https://kids.kiddle.co/Metallica "Metallica") and Slayer, have been influenced by his work.

## Music Career Highlights

### Starting Out in Music

King Diamond's first heavy rock band was called Brainstorm, from 1974 to 1976. After that, he sang with a Danish hard rock band called Black Rose. With Black Rose, he started adding horror-themed performances to his shows. He also began developing his unique stage character.

Later, he joined a punk-metal band called Brats, where he met Hank Shermann. They then helped another musician, Michael Denner, with his project, Danger Zone. This group, including Timi Hansen, eventually formed the band Mercyful Fate in 1980.

### Mercyful Fate Band

Main article: Mercyful Fate

After releasing their album _Don't Break the Oath_ in 1984 and touring the U.S. for the first time, King Diamond decided to start a solo career. He took two bandmates, Timi Hansen and Michael Denner, with him.

Mercyful Fate got back together in 1992. King Diamond continued his solo career at the same time. The band recorded five more albums. In 1999, King Diamond and Hank Shermann performed the song "Evil" live with [Metallica](https://kids.kiddle.co/Metallica "Metallica"). During this performance, King Diamond did not wear his famous makeup.

[![Image 4: King Diamond live 1999](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/0/0d/King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg/300px-King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg "Enlarge")

 King Diamond performing in 1999

In 2000, King Diamond decided to pause Mercyful Fate to focus on his solo music. However, on August 1, 2019, Mercyful Fate announced they would reunite for a European tour. In June 2022, they released a new song called "The Jackal of Salzburg." King Diamond confirmed in August 2022 that the band was working on a new album.

### King Diamond Solo Project

Main article: King Diamond (band)

In 2001, King Diamond sang backup vocals on a song called "Necronemesis" for the band Usurper. In 2004, he sang on "Sweet Dreams," a song by [Dave Grohl](https://kids.kiddle.co/Dave_Grohl "Dave Grohl")'s heavy metal project, Probot. In late 2005, King Diamond also sang on the _Roadrunner United – The All-Star Sessions_ album for the song "In the Fire." He also appeared on the Cradle of Filth song "Devil Woman" in late 2005.

In April 2006, King Diamond performed with [Mikkey Dee](https://kids.kiddle.co/Mikkey_Dee "Mikkey Dee"), the drummer for [Motörhead](https://kids.kiddle.co/Mot%C3%B6rhead "Motörhead"), in Sweden. King Diamond had previously called Dee "one of the best drummers of all time."

King Diamond released his album _Give Me Your Soul... Please_ on June 26, 2007. The band was nominated for a [Grammy](https://kids.kiddle.co/Grammy_Awards "Grammy Awards") Award for "Best Metal Performance" for their song "Never Ending Hill."

He had to cancel a U.S. tour because of severe back pain from a herniated disk. He believed the problem came from the long, stressful hours spent working on his album.

King Diamond appeared at Ozzfest on August 9, 2008, in Frisco, Texas. He performed a mix of Mercyful Fate songs with [Metallica](https://kids.kiddle.co/Metallica "Metallica"). He also sang a cover of the Pantera song "A New Level" with other musicians.

In 2009, King Diamond became a playable character in the video game _Guitar Hero: Metallica_. Players could unlock him by completing Mercyful Fate's song "Evil."

On November 29, 2010, King Diamond was hospitalized. Doctors found blockages in his arteries and determined he had experienced several heart attacks. He needed triple-bypass surgery, which was successful. He recovered at home, and all his music projects were put on hold temporarily.

On December 7, 2011, King Diamond joined Metallica on stage in San Francisco to celebrate Metallica's 30th anniversary. In June 2012, he performed his comeback concert at the Sweden Rock Festival.

On September 8, 2012, King Diamond appeared on VH1 Classic's _That Metal Show_ with Mark Tremonti. He discussed his surgery and upcoming plans.

[![Image 5: Tuska 20130628 - King Diamond - 32](https://kids.kiddle.co/images/thumb/5/5a/Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg/300px-Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg)](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg)

[](https://kids.kiddle.co/Image:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg "Enlarge")

 King Diamond in 2013

He provided guest vocals on the song "Room 24" for [Volbeat](https://kids.kiddle.co/Volbeat "Volbeat")'s 2013 album, _Outlaw Gentlemen & Shady Ladies_. In August 2013, King Diamond performed at the Open Air Bloodstock Festival in the UK.

Slayer was the main band for the 2015 Rockstar Energy Mayhem Festival. King Diamond's band also participated in this tour, along with other groups like HELLYEAH and [The Devil Wears Prada](https://kids.kiddle.co/The_Devil_Wears_Prada_(band) "The Devil Wears Prada (band)").

#### Other Appearances

King Diamond was a special guest star in four episodes of the [Warner Bros.](https://kids.kiddle.co/Warner_Bros. "Warner Bros.") cartoon _Metalocalypse_ in 2006. He voiced characters like the Blues Devil and a fast food manager.

## Stage Performance

When King Diamond performs on stage, he uses a special microphone stand. It is made from a [femur](https://kids.kiddle.co/Femur "Femur") bone and a [tibia](https://kids.kiddle.co/Tibia "Tibia") bone shaped like a [cross](https://kids.kiddle.co/Cross "Cross"). He used to use a real [human skull](https://kids.kiddle.co/Skull "Skull") named Melissa on stage, but it was stolen after a show in the Netherlands in the mid-1980s.

King Diamond has often changed his makeup design over the years. For his album _Conspiracy_, he wore black and white lines that looked like war paint, with some red "blood" on his forehead. For his album _The Puppet Master_, he used less white makeup and mostly had black crosses on his face.

## Musical Inspirations

King Diamond says that musicians like Arthur Brown, David Byron, [Alice Cooper](https://kids.kiddle.co/Alice_Cooper "Alice Cooper"), [Ronnie James Dio](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ronnie_James_Dio "Ronnie James Dio"), [Ian Gillan](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ian_Gillan "Ian Gillan"), [Ozzy Osbourne](https://kids.kiddle.co/Ozzy_Osbourne "Ozzy Osbourne"), and [Robert Plant](https://kids.kiddle.co/Robert_Plant "Robert Plant") are his main inspirations.

According to his official website, the first two albums he ever bought were [Deep Purple](https://kids.kiddle.co/Deep_Purple "Deep Purple")'s _Fireball_ and [Black Sabbath](https://kids.kiddle.co/Black_Sabbath "Black Sabbath")'s _Master of Reality_.

## Personal Beliefs

King Diamond follows a philosophy that he does not see as a religion. He believes that religion has caused a lot of conflict and destruction throughout history. He finds it difficult to understand why people fight over beliefs that cannot be proven. He has stated that he no longer believes in anything religious.

## Family Life

King Diamond is married to Livia Zita, a singer from Hungary. She has sung backup vocals on his albums _The Puppet Master_ and _Give Me Your Soul...Please_, and also performs live with him. She is also his business partner.

As of 2025, she is working with him to gather old video footage for two upcoming DVD releases of King Diamond and Mercyful Fate live shows. She also helped create updated versions of King Diamond's albums, including _The Spider's Lullabye_, _The Graveyard_, _Voodoo_, and _House of God_.

In March 2017, King Diamond and Livia Zita became parents to a son named Byron.

## Influence on Other Artists

Metallica released an 11-minute mix of five Mercyful Fate songs on their 1998 cover album _Garage Inc._. King Diamond has joined Metallica on stage three times to perform this medley: at the 1999 Gods of Metal festival in Italy, at the 2008 Ozzfest in Texas, and at a 2011 Metallica fan club show in California. For the 1999 and 2011 performances, Hank Shermann also joined on guitar.

King Diamond has been featured on the covers of many rock and metal magazines. He has influenced many artists, including [Metallica](https://kids.kiddle.co/Metallica "Metallica")'s [Lars Ulrich](https://kids.kiddle.co/Lars_Ulrich "Lars Ulrich"), Cradle of Filth, and Cage.

The American heavy metal band Cage dedicated a song to him called "King Diamond" on their 2007 album _Hell Destroyer_.

Musical artist

**Kim Bendix Petersen** (born 14 June 1956),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-bio-1) better known by his stage name **King Diamond**, is a Danish rock musician. As a vocalist, he is known for his powerful and wide-ranging [countertenor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Countertenor "Countertenor") singing voice, in particular his far-reaching [falsetto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falsetto "Falsetto") screams. He is the lead vocalist and lyricist for both [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate") and the eponymous [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)"). He also plays keyboards and guitars on studio recordings but uses live shows to focus solely on his vocal performance. Diamond is renowned for his dark lyrical content and his story concepts. He is also known for his distinctive [shock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shock_rock "Shock rock") stage persona (in particular his black and white facepaint). He has been an influence for other rock and metal artists, including [Metallica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metallica "Metallica"),[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-auto-3)[Slayer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slayer "Slayer")[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-Metal_Hammer-4) and [Cradle of Filth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cradle_of_Filth "Cradle of Filth").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-auto1-5).

## Career

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Career")]

### Early days

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Early days")]

Kim Petersen was born in [Hvidovre](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hvidovre "Hvidovre"), a suburb of [Copenhagen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copenhagen "Copenhagen"), [Denmark](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denmark "Denmark") on June 14, 1956. His father worked as a foreman at a storage facility, while his mother was secretary to the city's mayor. He grew up alongside his younger brother Stig. He revealed that growing up there was strict discipline in the way he and his brother were raised but lived a "very normal childhood." Petersen first became curious about occultism after listening to [Black Sabbath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Sabbath "Black Sabbath") and reading about [Jimmy Page's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Page "Jimmy Page") interest in [Aleister Crowley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aleister_Crowley "Aleister Crowley"). These interests eventually led to him reading the work of [Anton LaVey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anton_LaVey "Anton LaVey").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-6)

He attended basic school for 10 years and then attended college, where studied to become a lab assistant. By this time he was playing music but mostly as a hobby.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:2-7)

King Diamond's first [heavy rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") band was called Brainstorm (1974–76), with Jeanette Blum (Jean Blue) on vocals and bass, Michael Frohn (Mike West) on guitar and Jes Jacobsen (Jesse James) on drums. Diamond left Brainstorm and began singing with local Danish [hard rock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_rock "Hard rock") band Black Rose. He began experimenting with [horror](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horror_fiction "Horror fiction")-themed theatrics and shaping a malevolent quasi-[Satanic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satanism "Satanism") stage persona. He left Black Rose and joined the [punk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punk_rock "Punk rock")-[metal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heavy_metal_music "Heavy metal music") band Brats, where he met [Hank Shermann](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hank_Shermann "Hank Shermann"). The two were soon asked to help Michael Denner (also formerly a member of Brats) with his own project, Danger Zone. This band included [Timi Hansen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen "Timi Hansen"), and the musicians would join with Diamond in 1980 to become [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate").

### Mercyful Fate

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Mercyful Fate")]

Main article: [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate")

When Diamond first started Mercyful Fate, the band was not making much money and was taking up a lot of his time. Eventually, he decided to quit his job and live off of [social security](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welfare_spending "Welfare spending") in order to focus on the band. Not long afterward, however, Mercyful Fate began to take off.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:2-7)

Following Mercyful Fate's 1984 release of _[Don't Break the Oath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don't\_Break\_the\_Oath "Don't Break the Oath")_ and the subsequent tour (which saw them play in the U.S. for the first time), Diamond split ways with Mercyful Fate. With him, he took two of his bandmates (Hansen and Denner) to pursue a solo career under his own name.

Mercyful Fate reunited in 1992 (while Diamond simultaneously continued his solo career) and recorded five more studio albums. In 1999, Diamond and Hank Shermann performed the song "Evil" live with [Metallica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metallica "Metallica"). This performance also featured Diamond without his famous makeup.

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg/250px-King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:King_Diamond_live_1999.jpg)

King Diamond in 1999

In 2000, Diamond decided to put Mercyful Fate on hold and continue on with his solo career.

On 1 August 2019, Mercyful Fate announced a reunion and an accompanying European tour.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-8) On 2 June 2022, Mercyful Fate performed their first live show since 1999 in [Hanover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanover "Hanover") as part of a European tour, where they debuted a brand new song titled "The Jackal of Salzbur." King Diamond also confirmed that the band was actively working on a new album.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-9)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-10) However, in January 2025 the band's bass player, Becky Baldwin, stated that the new Mercyful Fate album was not expected to be released before 2025, due to King Diamond's focus on his namesake band's upcoming thirteenth studio album.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-11)

### King Diamond

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=King_Diamond&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: King Diamond")]

Main article: [King Diamond (band)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)")

After Mercyful Fate broke up, King Diamond, along with Michael Denner and [Timi Hansen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timi_Hansen "Timi Hansen"), formed the eponymous [King Diamond](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond_(band) "King Diamond (band)") band in 1985.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-12)_[Fatal Portrait](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fatal\_Portrait "Fatal Portrait")_, the band's first full-length studio album, was released on 14 March 1986, through [Roadrunner Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roadrunner_Records "Roadrunner Records").[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-13) Their second album _[Abigail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abigail\_(album) "Abigail (album)")_, was released on 29 May 1987 was the first [concept album](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concept_album "Concept album") based on an original story by Diamond.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-14) Following some line up changes another concept album, _"[Them](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Them\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "Them (King Diamond album)")"_ charted at number 38 on the [Swedish album chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Albums_Chart "Swedish Albums Chart"), number 65 on the [Dutch album chart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dutch_Album_Top_100 "Dutch Album Top 100"), and at number 89 on the [_Billboard_ 200](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_200 "Billboard 200"), making it King Diamond's highest charting album in the U.S. to date.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-15)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-16) Diamonds album a continuation of the storyline from _"Them"_, _[Conspiracy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conspiracy\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "Conspiracy (King Diamond album)")_ was the first King Diamond album to be recorded in the United States and was released in 1989. The next album _[The Eye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Eye\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "The Eye (King Diamond album)")_ was released the following year in 1990, however King Diamond reunited with Mercyful Fate in 1992 where he would then balance recording and touring with both Mercyful Fate and his eponymous band throughout the 1990s.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-18) After recording and touring with Mercyful Fate, King Diamond reformed his eponymous band in 1994.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-19) Released on 1 October 1996, _[The Graveyard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Graveyard\_(album) "The Graveyard (album)")_ saw King Diamond return to writing concept albums this was then followed by 1998 _[Voodoo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voodoo\_(King\_Diamond\_album) "Voodoo (King Diamond album)")._[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-20) Then when Mercyful Fate was put on hold in 1999, King Diamond began recording the album _[House of God](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House\_of\_God\_(album) "House of God (album)")_ at the Nomad Recording Studio in [Carrollton, Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carrollton,_Texas "Carrollton, Texas").[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-21)

In 2001, King Diamond worked out a deal with the band Usurper to sing backup vocals on the song "Necronemesis" in exchange for them shifting their recording schedule around to accommodate the recording of _[Abigail II: The Revenge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abigail\_II:\_The\_Revenge "Abigail II: The Revenge")_. In 2003 King Diamond released their eleventh album _[The Puppet Master](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Puppet\_Master\_(album) "The Puppet Master (album)")_, the album also featured additional vocals from Diamond's wife [Livia Zita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Livia_Zita "Livia Zita").[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-22) In 2004, Diamond contributed vocals to "Sweet Dreams", the final track on the album of [Dave Grohl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dave_Grohl "Dave Grohl")'s heavy metal side project [Probot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probot "Probot"). In late 2005, Diamond appeared on the _[Roadrunner United](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roadrunner\_United "Roadrunner United") – The All-Star Sessions_ album, contributing vocals for his song "In the Fire", which featured multiple Roadrunner Records musicians (past and present) working together to create individual songs. Diamond also guested on the [Cradle of Filth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cradle_of_Filth "Cradle of Filth") song "Devil Woman" in late 2005.

In April 2006, Diamond reunited with [Mikkey Dee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mikkey_Dee "Mikkey Dee") ([Motörhead](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mot%C3%B6rhead "Motörhead") drummer) at a sold-out gig at Kåren in [Gothenburg, Sweden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gothenburg,_Sweden "Gothenburg, Sweden").[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-23) In 2001 he referred to Dee as "one of the best drummers of all time and that's something that has bothered us since he left."[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-24)

Diamond released his album _[Give Me Your Soul... Please](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Give\_Me\_Your\_Soul...\_Please "Give Me Your Soul... Please")_, on 26 June 2007. The band received a [Grammy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy "Grammy") nomination in the "Best Metal Performance" category for the track "Never Ending Hill".[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-Blabbermouth.net-25)

He was forced to cancel a United States tour due to a herniated disk, causing severe back pain, which puts him in intense pain almost all of the time.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-26) He attributes the problem to the long stressful hours spent working on the album.

Diamond made an appearance at [Ozzfest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozzfest "Ozzfest") on 9 August 2008 at Frisco, Texas alongside [Metallica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metallica "Metallica"), performing a medley of Mercyful Fate songs previously released on Metallica's _[Garage Inc.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garage\_Inc. "Garage Inc.")_ album. He also performed a cover of the [Pantera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pantera "Pantera") song "A New Level" with [Vinnie Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vinnie_Paul "Vinnie Paul"), [Scott Ian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scott_Ian "Scott Ian"), [Max Cavalera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Max_Cavalera "Max Cavalera"), and Nick Bowcott.

In 2009, Diamond was revealed to be a playable character for the [rhythm game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhythm_game "Rhythm game")_[Guitar Hero: Metallica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guitar\_Hero:\_Metallica "Guitar Hero: Metallica")_, appearing with Mercyful Fate's song "Evil". The player must complete the song on any instrument and any difficulty to unlock the character.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-27)

On 29 November 2010, Diamond was taken to the hospital, where doctors discovered several blockages in his arteries due to his heavy smoking habit. They determined that he had had several heart attacks and that he needed [triple-bypass surgery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coronary_artery_bypass_surgery "Coronary artery bypass surgery"), during which time he was medically dead for five hours.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-28) The surgery was performed successfully and on 11 December 2010 it was announced that he was at home recovering.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-29) All his musical projects were placed on hold.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-30)

On 7 December 2011, Diamond appeared on stage with Metallica at the Fillmore in San Francisco to celebrate Metallica's 30th anniversary.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-31)

In June 2012, Diamond performed his comeback concert at [Sweden Rock Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sweden_Rock_Festival "Sweden Rock Festival").

On Saturday 8 September 2012, Diamond appeared along with [Mark Tremonti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Tremonti "Mark Tremonti") on VH1 Classic's _[That Metal Show](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/That\_Metal\_Show "That Metal Show")_ discussing his surgery and various details about upcoming events.

[![Image 6](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5a/Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg/250px-Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Tuska_20130628_-_King_Diamond_-_32.jpg)

King Diamond in 2013

He appeared on [Volbeat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volbeat "Volbeat")'s 2013 album, _[Outlaw Gentlemen & Shady Ladies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outlaw\_Gentlemen\_&\_Shady\_Ladies "Outlaw Gentlemen & Shady Ladies")_, providing guest vocals on the track "Room 24".[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-32) This collaboration resulted in another Grammy nomination for Best Metal Performance at the [56th Annual Grammy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/56th_Annual_Grammy_Awards "56th Annual Grammy Awards").[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:0-33) In August 2013 Diamond performed at Open Air Bloodstock Festival, UK.

[Slayer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slayer "Slayer") was chosen to headline the 2015 Rockstar Energy Mayhem Festival. The bands [HELLYEAH](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HELLYEAH "HELLYEAH"), King Diamond, [The Devil Wears Prada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Devil_Wears_Prada_(band) "The Devil Wears Prada (band)"), [Thy Art Is Murder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thy_Art_Is_Murder "Thy Art Is Murder"), [Jungle Rot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jungle_Rot "Jungle Rot"), [Sister Sin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sister_Sin "Sister Sin"), [Sworn In](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sworn_In_(band) "Sworn In (band)"), [Shattered Sun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shattered_Sun "Shattered Sun"), Feed Her To The Sharks, [Code Orange](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_Orange_(band) "Code Orange (band)") and Kissing Candice also participated in the Rockstar Tour.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-34)

In 2018, King Diamond began work on its thirteenth studio album, which would be divided into two parts to connect with its theme. The first part of the series was later revealed to be titled _The Institute_; the title has since been changed to _Saint Lucifer's Hospital 1920_. Originally intended for release in 2020, it faced multiple delays before its planned release in 2026. This delay was in part due to Diamond taking his time on perfecting new material by both the King Diamond band and the reunited [Mercyful Fate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercyful_Fate "Mercyful Fate").[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-36)

In the spring and summer of 2025, King Diamond toured Europe, bringing along [Paradise Lost](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paradise_Lost_(band) "Paradise Lost (band)"), [Angel Witch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angel_Witch "Angel Witch") and [Unto Others](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unto_Others_(band) "Unto Others (band)").[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-37) In November of 2025 Diamond was honored by the [Danish Arts Foundation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danish_Arts_Foundation "Danish Arts Foundation") and was given the lifetime honour for his "very special efforts and contributions to Danish art and cultural life." In addition Diamond will receive a yearly 189,000 Danish Krona (about $26,000) grant from the foundation for the rest of his life.[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-:1-38)[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-39)

On September 12, 2026, Diamond joined [My Chemical Romance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Chemical_Romance "My Chemical Romance") on stage at the [Alamodome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alamodome "Alamodome") in [San Antonio, Texas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Antonio "San Antonio") to perform the song "[Mama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mama_(My_Chemical_Romance_song) "Mama (My Chemical Romance song)")".[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Diamond#cite_note-40)
